body: 新增 2 則科學文獻；無新試驗、無試驗狀態異動、無公司里程碑。①SCA7 表現型擴充至眼底血管樣條紋（Journal of Neurology 273(10):589，2026/09/11）：中國鄭州河南省人民醫院（Cao C 等、通訊 Zhang J，doi:10.1007/s00415-026-14081-9）報告 SCA7 家系出現血管樣條紋（angioid streaks）此一先前未歸入 SCA7 光譜的眼底變化，並觀察到家族內表現差異。SCA7 是唯一以進行性失明合併共濟失調為特徵的 polyQ SCA，眼科終點在其試驗設計中份量特別重。⚠️ 本筆為 Letter、PubMed 無摘要、Springer 全文付費牆——本站僅核實標題、關鍵詞與刊載資訊，家系人數、CAG 重複長度、視力數據一律留白不臆測。②SCA8 以早發型帕金森症表現、改用皮下持續輸注 foscarbidopa/foslevodopa（Clinical Parkinsonism & Related Disorders 15:100496，2026/08/27 線上、2026/09/11 收錄 PubMed）：美國 Mayo Clinic 羅徹斯特院區（Onorati F 等、通訊 Savica R，doi:10.1016/j.prdoa.2026.100496，CC BY 全文開放）投書回應他人「SCA8 併帕金森症以 DBS 治療」的病例，提出一名 27 歲男性，因短讀長定序偵測重複擴增能力有限而改做長讀長全基因體定序，方確診 ATXN8/ATXN8OS 71 個 CTG 重複；腦部 MRI 未見小腦萎縮。口服 levodopa 出現異動症與藥效波動後，2025/06 改皮下輸注，on 狀態 MDS-UPDRS III／IV 自 22／10 降至 5／4。兩點值得記下：短讀長定序會漏掉重複擴增；且此病人無小腦萎縮、無共濟失調主訴，以 SARA 為門檻的 SCA 試驗篩選不到這類病人。⚠️ n=1、開放標籤、無對照；治療為純症狀性多巴胺補充而非疾病修飾，不構成本社競品；SCA8 亦不在本社 polyQ SCA 適應症內。本日判斷紀錄：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢窗內無新的療法型試驗、亦無追蹤中資產狀態異動——最近更新仍為 09/08 IntraBio NCT07221292（已於 09/08 記錄），其餘近期更新（Kissei NCT07040137、Larimar NCT06447025／NCT07778836、Biogen NCT02255435／NCT06054893、Lexeo NCT07721025）皆為平台既有筆數且狀態未變；SBMA 組仍被前列腺癌試驗灌入、CACNA1A 組夾帶無關試驗，均逐筆確認後排除。PubMed 窗內另有四筆不予收錄：Sylvian 裂表皮樣囊腫致共濟失調個案（PubMed 42725288）、維生素 E 缺乏性共濟失調 TTPA 複合等位基因分子鑑定（PubMed 42711446）、乳癌相關副腫瘤性眼陣攣—肌陣攣共濟失調兩例（PubMed 42711042）均為後天性或非追蹤圈層之共濟失調；巴西 AOA2（SETX）個案通訊（PubMed 42715900）已於 09/10 記錄排除理由。公司新聞面窗內無任何一手公開里程碑：Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL；Steminent／REPROCELL 仍為日本上市許可申請審查中；Arrowhead／Sarepta、Vico、安基、PTC、Larimar、Lexeo、Solid、IntraBio、Kissei 窗內均無新公告。

en.body: Two papers added; no new trials, no trial status changes and no company milestones. (1) The SCA7 phenotype extended to angioid streaks on fundoscopy (Journal of Neurology 273(10):589, 2026/09/11): Henan Provincial People's Hospital in Zhengzhou, China (Cao C et al., corresponding author Zhang J, doi:10.1007/s00415-026-14081-9) reports angioid streaks — a fundus finding not previously placed within the SCA7 spectrum — in an SCA7 family, together with intrafamilial phenotypic variability. SCA7 is the one polyQ SCA defined by progressive visual loss alongside ataxia, so ophthalmic endpoints carry unusual weight in its trial design. ⚠️ This is a Letter, PubMed carries no abstract and the Springer full text is paywalled — only the title, keywords and publication details are verified here, and family size, CAG repeat lengths and visual measurements are deliberately left blank rather than guessed. (2) SCA8 presenting as early-onset parkinsonism, switched to continuous subcutaneous foscarbidopa/foslevodopa (Clinical Parkinsonism & Related Disorders 15:100496, online 2026/08/27, indexed in PubMed 2026/09/11): Mayo Clinic Rochester (Onorati F et al., corresponding author Savica R, doi:10.1016/j.prdoa.2026.100496, CC BY open access) writes in response to another group's case of SCA8 with parkinsonism treated by DBS, describing a 27-year-old man in whom long-read whole genome sequencing was needed to identify an ATXN8/ATXN8OS expansion of 71 CTG repeats, because short-read sequencing detects repeat expansions poorly; brain MRI showed no cerebellar atrophy. After oral levodopa produced dyskinesias and wearing-off, he was switched to subcutaneous infusion in June 2025, and on-state MDS-UPDRS III/IV fell from 22/10 to 5/4. Two points worth recording: short-read sequencing misses repeat expansions; and this patient had no cerebellar atrophy and no ataxia complaint, so an SCA trial screening on SARA would not have found him. ⚠️ n=1, open label, uncontrolled; the treatment is purely symptomatic dopamine replacement rather than disease modification, so it is not a competitor to Steminent, and SCA8 falls outside Steminent's polyQ SCA indication. Decisions logged today: across the five CT.gov indication queries there were no new therapeutic trials and no status changes among tracked assets — the most recent update remains IntraBio's NCT07221292 of 09/08 (recorded on 09/08), and the other recent updates (Kissei NCT07040137, Larimar NCT06447025 and NCT07778836, Biogen NCT02255435 and NCT06054893, Lexeo NCT07721025) are all already on the platform with unchanged status. The SBMA query remains flooded with prostate cancer trials and the CACNA1A query carries unrelated studies; each was checked and excluded. Four further PubMed hits were not recorded: a Sylvian fissure epidermoid cyst causing ataxia (PubMed 42725288), molecular characterisation of a TTPA complex allele in ataxia with vitamin E deficiency (PubMed 42711446) and two cases of paraneoplastic opsoclonus-myoclonus ataxia with breast carcinoma (PubMed 42711042) are acquired ataxias or fall outside the tracked rings; the Brazilian AOA2 (SETX) case letter (PubMed 42715900) was already excluded with reasons given on 09/10. No first-party public milestone occurred on the company news side: Biohaven's troriluzole remains at the CRL of 2025-11-04; Steminent/REPROCELL remain under review for Japanese marketing authorisation; and Arrowhead/Sarepta, Vico, AnnJi, PTC, Larimar, Lexeo, Solid, IntraBio and Kissei issued nothing in the window.

body: 新增 3 則科學文獻，並補充 1 筆臨床評估量表的驗證資料；無新試驗、無試驗狀態異動。①PROM-Ataxia 在 SCA 的一年縱貫驗證與 MCID（Journal of Neurology 273(10):583，2026/09/09）：荷蘭 Radboud 大學醫學中心（Leeuwenberg 等，doi:10.1007/s00415-026-14108-1）以 76 名 SCA1／SCA3／SCA7 帶因者（68 人完成一年追蹤）驗證病人自陳量表 PROM-Ataxia：與 SARA 等量表中度至高度相關（ρ=0.46–0.89）、可區分前共濟失調帶因者與健康對照，但一年群體反應度低（SRM=0.17），MCID 估計 9.8–12.7 分——意味它較適合作為反應者分析門檻或次要終點，而非一年期試驗的主要終點。SCA 知識庫「臨床評估量表」的 PROM-Ataxia 條目已同步補入此驗證。⚠️ 通訊作者之一自陳曾任 Vico、Biohaven、Biogen 科學顧問，已於文獻卡照錄。②polyQ 疾病 microRNA 回顧（Neurobiology of Disease，2026/09/09）：中國醫大盛京醫院（Liu Y 等，doi:10.1016/j.nbd.2026.107603）彙整九種 polyQ 疾病的 miRNA 機轉、循環生物標記與 AAV 人工 miRNA／外泌體療法（臨床前針對 HTT、ATXN1、ATXN3、ATXN7）。⚠️ 敘述性回顧、無新數據，SCA 部分全屬臨床前。③SBMA 跌倒負擔問卷（Physiotherapy Research International，2026/09/07 收錄）：UCL Queen Square（Lee LE 等，doi:10.1002/pri.70342）61 名病人中 90% 一年內曾跌倒、69% 至少每月跌倒，多歸因於肌無力。SBMA 為安基 AJ201 所屬 polyQ 鄰近圈層。⚠️ 單中心自陳回憶、無療法資料。本日判斷紀錄：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢窗內無新的療法型試驗、亦無追蹤中資產狀態異動（最近一筆仍為 09/08 IntraBio NCT07221292，已於前日記錄）；SBMA 組仍被前列腺癌試驗灌入，逐筆確認後排除。PubMed 窗內另有兩筆不予收錄：巴西 AOA2（SETX 複合異型合子）個案通訊（Clinics，PubMed 42715900）屬體染色體隱性共濟失調、與追蹤資產無關；福建醫大附一 tACS 治療 MSA-C 的隨機對照試驗（Brain Stimulation，PubMed 42716220）適應症為 MSA，已收錄於姊妹站 MSA-IQ。公司新聞面窗內無任何一手公開里程碑：Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL；Steminent／REPROCELL 仍為日本上市許可申請審查中（2026/06/24 送件、PMDA 優先審查）；Vico VO659 最新一手公告仍為 2026/02；Arrowhead／Sarepta、安基、PTC、Larimar、Lexeo、Solid、IntraBio、Kissei 窗內均無新公告。

en.body: Three papers added and one clinical assessment scale entry updated with new validation data; no new trials and no changes in trial status. (1) One-year longitudinal validation and MCID of PROM-Ataxia in SCA (Journal of Neurology 273(10):583, 2026/09/09): Radboud University Medical Center (Leeuwenberg et al., doi:10.1007/s00415-026-14108-1) validated the patient-reported PROM-Ataxia in 76 SCA1/SCA3/SCA7 carriers (68 with one-year follow-up). It correlated moderately to strongly with SARA and other scales (ρ=0.46–0.89) and distinguished pre-ataxic carriers from healthy controls, but group-level responsiveness over one year was low (SRM=0.17), with an estimated MCID of 9.8–12.7 points — suggesting it is better suited as a responder-analysis threshold or secondary endpoint than as the primary endpoint of a one-year trial. The PROM-Ataxia entry in the SCA knowledge base's clinical assessment scales has been updated with this validation. ⚠️ A co-senior author reports having served as a scientific adviser to Vico, Biohaven and Biogen, which is recorded on the paper card. (2) Review of microRNAs in polyQ diseases (Neurobiology of Disease, 2026/09/09): Shengjing Hospital of China Medical University (Liu Y et al., doi:10.1016/j.nbd.2026.107603) surveys miRNA mechanisms, circulating biomarkers and AAV-delivered artificial miRNA and exosome therapeutics (preclinical, targeting HTT, ATXN1, ATXN3 and ATXN7) across the nine polyQ diseases. ⚠️ A narrative review with no new data; all SCA content is preclinical. (3) Falls burden survey in SBMA (Physiotherapy Research International, indexed 2026/09/07): of 61 patients surveyed by UCL Queen Square (Lee LE et al., doi:10.1002/pri.70342), 90% had fallen within a year and 69% fell at least monthly, mostly attributing falls to weakness. SBMA sits in the adjacent polyQ ring targeted by AnnJi's AJ201. ⚠️ Single-centre self-reported recall; no therapy data. Decisions logged today: across the five CT.gov indication queries there were no new therapeutic trials and no status changes among tracked assets (the most recent change remains IntraBio's NCT07221292 on 09/08, recorded the previous day); the SBMA query is still flooded with prostate cancer trials, each checked and excluded. Two PubMed hits were not recorded: a Brazilian AOA2 case letter (compound heterozygous SETX variants; Clinics, PubMed 42715900) concerns an autosomal recessive ataxia unrelated to tracked assets; and the Fujian Medical University randomised trial of tACS in MSA-C (Brain Stimulation, PubMed 42716220) is an MSA study and has been recorded on the sister site MSA-IQ. No first-party public milestone occurred on the company news side: Biohaven's troriluzole remains at the CRL of 2025-11-04; Steminent/REPROCELL remain under review for Japanese marketing authorisation (filed 2026/06/24, PMDA priority review); Vico's VO659 still has 2026/02 as its latest first-party announcement; and Arrowhead/Sarepta, AnnJi, PTC, Larimar, Lexeo, Solid, IntraBio and Kissei issued nothing in the window.

body: 新增 3 則科學文獻，無新試驗、無試驗狀態異動。①台灣團隊指認 KV4.3 選擇性過濾器上的首個致病變異（Movement Disorders，2026/09/09）：彰化基督教醫院、台大、陽明交大與中國醫藥大學合作（Lee CJ 等、通訊 Liu CS，doi:10.1002/mds.70514），在一對同卵雙胞胎身上以全外顯子定序找到位於 KCND3「TLGYG」選擇性過濾器的異型合子 de novo p.L368P 變異——該區段過去從未有致病變異被指認。結構模擬顯示孔徑縮小阻礙鉀離子通透，生化顯示蛋白表現與運輸受損，電生理證實鉀電流完全喪失並對野生型產生顯著顯性負向效應；臨床表現為重度智能障礙、發展遲緩、小腦萎縮併橋腦扁平、無癲癇。⚠️ n=2 之個案級證據，SCA19/22 非本社 polyQ 適應症、亦不在任何競品試驗收案範圍，全文無療效或藥物資料。②紐西蘭 ILOCA 世代顯示 SCA27B 佔顯著比例（Neurology: Genetics 12(5):e200424，2026/09/01）：奧克蘭市立醫院團隊（Anderson SC 等，doi:10.1212/NXG.0000000000200424）對先前基因套組陰性的病人改以擴充版重複擴增套組重驗，29 人中 11 人（38%）取得診斷——9 人為 FGF14 擴增（SCA27B）、RFC1 與 TBP 各 1 人。SCA27B 個案臨床樣貌與歐洲一致（平均發病 56 歲、早期可呈陣發性，2 人有軟顎震顫）；7 人重複次數 >250，另 2 人落在 200–250 邊界卻具符合表現型，提示現行門檻可能漏診邊界個案。③阿根廷首例基因確診 SCA27B（Parkinsonism & Related Disorders 152，2026/09/01）：Gatto EM 等（doi:10.1016/j.parkreldis.2026.108965）報告該病人最初被誤診為酒精性小腦退化。②③兩筆指向同一件事的兩面：SCA27B 在晚發型共濟失調中被系統性低估，而 SCA27B 為 Solaxa（SLX-100）鎖定之適應症、屬本站鄰近共濟失調圈層，診斷落差直接影響該亞型未來試驗的可及收案母體。⚠️ 兩筆皆無任何療法或試驗資料；③為 n=1 個案報告且原文摘要極簡，本站未補寫未載明的數字。本日判斷紀錄：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢窗內無任何新的療法型試驗，亦無追蹤中資產的狀態異動——SCA 組窗內異動除已在檔者外，僅 Lexeo FA-CM 病程研究（NCT06865482）、TreatHSP 平台（NCT07798674）、FARA UNIFIED（NCT06016946）、NINDS 表現型／基因型（NCT00018889）等觀察性研究，與福建醫大附一 SCA3 經顱時間干涉刺激（NCT07743866）及 Baltuch 小腦深部腦刺激（NCT07752095）等神經調節研究，全數依 §1b 排除；SBMA 組一如手冊所載仍被前列腺癌試驗灌入，逐筆確認後排除；polyglutamine 組四筆全為已收錄或陳舊登錄。另記一筆排除判斷：PubMed 窗內另有 SCAR10／ANO10 早期單純下跳性眼震之個案報告（Neurogenetics，PubMed 42702636），屬體染色體隱性共濟失調、與本站追蹤之 polyQ 資產及任何競品開發線均無關聯，依「與追蹤資產無關者不加」原則不予收錄。公司新聞面窗內無任何一手公開里程碑：Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL；Steminent／REPROCELL 仍為日本上市許可申請審查中（2026/06/24 送件、PMDA 優先審查）；Vico VO659 最新一手公告仍為 2026/02；Arrowhead／Sarepta、安基、PTC、Larimar、Lexeo、Solid、IntraBio、Kissei 窗內均無新公告。

en.body: Three papers added; no new trials and no changes in trial status. (1) A Taiwanese group identifies the first pathogenic variant in the KV4.3 selectivity filter (Movement Disorders, 2026/09/09): a collaboration between Changhua Christian Hospital, National Taiwan University, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University and China Medical University (Lee CJ et al., corresponding author Liu CS, doi:10.1002/mds.70514) used whole-exome sequencing in a pair of monozygotic twins to find a heterozygous de novo p.L368P variant in the 'TLGYG' selectivity filter of KCND3 — a segment in which no pathogenic variant had previously been identified. Structural modelling showed a reduced pore radius obstructing potassium permeation, biochemistry showed impaired expression and trafficking, and electrophysiology confirmed total loss of potassium current with a pronounced dominant-negative effect on wild-type channels; clinically the twins had severe intellectual disability, developmental delay and cerebellar atrophy with pontine flattening, without seizures. ⚠️ Case-level evidence at n=2; SCA19/22 is not a polyQ indication for Steminent and falls outside every competitor trial's eligibility; the paper contains no efficacy or drug data. (2) A New Zealand ILOCA cohort finds SCA27B accounts for a substantial share (Neurology: Genetics 12(5):e200424, 2026/09/01): the Auckland City Hospital group (Anderson SC et al., doi:10.1212/NXG.0000000000200424) retested patients whose earlier ataxia gene panels were negative on an expanded repeat expansion panel, and 11 of 29 (38%) received a diagnosis — nine with FGF14 expansions (SCA27B), one RFC1 and one TBP. The SCA27B cases matched European descriptions (mean onset 56 years, episodic presentations early on, two with palatal tremor); seven had >250 repeats while two more fell in the 200–250 borderline range yet had a consistent phenotype, suggesting the current threshold may miss borderline cases. (3) The first genetically confirmed Argentinean case of SCA27B (Parkinsonism & Related Disorders 152, 2026/09/01): Gatto EM et al. (doi:10.1016/j.parkreldis.2026.108965) report a patient initially misdiagnosed with alcoholic cerebellar degeneration. Items (2) and (3) show two faces of one problem — SCA27B is systematically under-recognised among late-onset ataxias — and SCA27B is the indication targeted by Solaxa's SLX-100 within this platform's adjacent-ataxia ring, so the diagnostic gap bears directly on the recruitable population for future trials in that subtype. ⚠️ Neither paper carries any therapy or trial data; (3) is an n=1 case report whose published abstract is extremely brief, and no figures have been supplied here that the source does not state. Decisions logged today: across the five CT.gov indication queries there were no new therapeutic trials and no status changes among tracked assets. Beyond studies already on file, the in-window SCA hits were observational — Lexeo's FA-CM disease-course study (NCT06865482), the TreatHSP platform (NCT07798674), FARA's UNIFIED natural history study (NCT06016946) and the NINDS phenotype/genotype study (NCT00018889) — or neuromodulation — transcranial temporal interference stimulation for SCA3 at Fujian Medical University (NCT07743866) and Baltuch's cerebellar deep brain stimulation study (NCT07752095) — all excluded under §1b. The SBMA query remains flooded with prostate cancer trials exactly as the manual describes and was checked case by case; all four polyglutamine hits were already on file or long stale. One further exclusion is logged: PubMed also returned a case report of isolated early downbeat nystagmus in SCAR10/ANO10 (Neurogenetics, PubMed 42702636), which concerns an autosomal recessive ataxia unconnected to the polyQ assets and competitor programmes tracked here, and was not recorded, under the rule that material unrelated to tracked assets is not added. No first-party public milestone occurred on the company news side: Biohaven's troriluzole remains at the CRL of 2025-11-04; Steminent/REPROCELL remain under review for Japanese marketing authorisation (filed 2026/06/24, PMDA priority review); Vico's VO659 still has 2026/02 as its latest first-party announcement; and Arrowhead/Sarepta, AnnJi, PTC, Larimar, Lexeo, Solid, IntraBio and Kissei issued nothing in the window.

en.body: Two trial registrations added, both filling pre-existing gaps; no new papers. (1) Proactive sweep: the clenbuterol Phase 2 in SBMA from Padova University Hospital (NCT06169046, BetaSBMA) — a beta-2 agonist repurposing, 0.04 mg/day orally for 48 weeks, n=90 (estimated), single Italian site, with the Mario Negri Institute as collaborator and a six-minute walk test at week 48 as the primary endpoint. ⚠️ No registry update since 2024-04-15, so "recruiting" is a stale sponsor entry; the indication is Kennedy's disease in the adjacent polyQ ring rather than SCA, and it is a symptomatic / functional study whose primary endpoint is walking endurance rather than an ataxia scale, so it does not address disease course. (2) Weekly roll-call: Minoryx's leriglitazone Phase 2 in Friedreich's ataxia (NCT03917225, FRAMES) — last updated 2022-10-13, exactly the case the manual's §1b-2 describes, where a long-dormant trial can never surface in a date-sorted condition query and only a drug-name search retrieves it. It enrolled 39 patients across Belgium, France, Germany and Spain, completed in September 2020, and is marked completed with no results posted on CT.gov; the company's announcement and the 2022 Neurology publication both report the primary endpoint (C2–C3 cervical cord area) as not significant / inconclusive, and the claimed reduction in upper-limb ataxia decline rests on secondary endpoints and post-hoc analysis rather than proof of efficacy. The asset's development has since moved to X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy (NCT05819866, Ph3), with no follow-on pivotal Friedreich's trial registered. Decisions logged today: the Friedreich and CACNA1A queries also surfaced NCT06623890 (Biogen omaveloxolone post-marketing registry), NCT07013292 (retrospective dysphagia study, CHU Nice), NCT06016946 (FARA UNIFIED natural history) and NCT04944940 / NCT07443449 (SBMA biomarker and registry studies); each was checked individually and confirmed to be observational, registry or retrospective rather than an interventional therapy trial, so all five were excluded under the §1b criteria. The four PubMed hits from the past seven days (including the iScience Importin-8 paper and the Astragalus SCA3 trial) were already recorded on 09/06 on de-duplication, so nothing was added.

body: 本次新增 2 則科學文獻＋1 筆回補試驗登錄。①回補試驗：Biogen（原 Reata）omaveloxolone 的樞紐 Ph2 試驗 MOXIe（NCT02255435），登錄於 2026/09/03 更新而被本次掃描帶出，經比對確認為平台先前未收錄之缺漏。這是共濟失調領域唯一已核准藥物的樞紐試驗（支持 2023 年成為全球第一個核准的 Friedreich's ataxia 療法），實收 172 人、含美／澳／奧／義／英五國站點、結果已於 2022/11/29 登錄。已公開讀出（Lynch 等，Ann Neurol 2021）：第 2 部分隨機 103 人，第 48 週 mFARS 變化 −1.55 對安慰劑 +0.85，組間差 −2.40 ± 0.96、p = 0.014，達主要指標，安全性見可逆的轉胺酶上升。特別註記：本試驗的註冊主要指標是 mFARS、不是 SARA——與本社及 Kissei rovatirelin 採用的 SARA 屬不同量表，引用監管先例時不可混用。②文獻：(a) 葡萄牙／德國團隊在 iScience 提出 SCA3 的全新治療標的 Importin-8（doi:10.1016/j.isci.2026.116446，線上先行 2026/08/26）——系統性篩選 34 個核質運輸蛋白後選定 Ipo8，發現其 mRNA 在 MJD／SCA3 模型中上升，下調 Ipo8 可減少 Ataxin-3 聚集與神經元功能失常、並在活體緩解共濟失調行為，機轉推測經由 NF-κB/p65 與 Argonaute-2。這條路線不去動 ATXN3 本身、而是改變突變蛋白的運輸去向，與 VO659、ARO-ATXN2 的「減少產生」路線互補；(b) 台灣團隊在 J Tradit Complement Med 發表黃耆治療 SCA3 的隨機三盲安慰劑對照交叉試驗（doi:10.1016/j.jtcme.2026.06.002，2026/09 期別）——n=32、23 人完成，組內 NfL 小幅下降（27.6→25.6 pg/mL，P = 0.040）、胰島素上升（P = 0.004），但調整後迴歸模型的組間 NfL 差異未達顯著（P = 0.127）。本站收錄係作為生物標記方法學警示（組內差異顯著、組間不顯著的教科書案例，NfL 的組內波動不足以支持療效主張）與台灣本地臨床量能的參考，不構成療效背書。⚠️ 兩篇限制：(a) 全為細胞與小鼠，Importin-8 無對應臨床候選藥、無公司、無試驗登錄，且廣泛表現之核輸入受體的全身性抑制安全性未評估；(b) 主要分析為陰性結果，樣本小、療程僅三個月，黃耆亦非本平台追蹤的療法型競品。本次其餘掃描結果：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich's／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）窗內其餘異動皆為已收錄或依 §1b 應排除者——Kissei NCT07040137、IntraBio NCT07221292、Biogen NCT06054893、Larimar NCT06447025／NCT07778836、Lexeo NCT07721025、Solid NCT07180355、PTC NCT07681713、Vico NCT05822908 均已在檔且狀態未變；Lexeo NCT06865482、FARA UNIFIED NCT06016946、海德堡 TreatHSP NCT07798674、NINDS NCT00018889、NEI NCT02741440、RISCA NCT01037777 屬觀察性；福建醫科大學附屬第一醫院 NCT07743866（SCA3 顳葉干擾刺激）與 Baltuch NCT07752095（SCA1／SCA3 小腦深腦刺激）屬神經調節、依 §1b 排除；SBMA 組一如手冊所載仍被前列腺癌試驗灌入，polyglutamine 組四筆全為已收錄或陳舊登錄。PubMed 窗內共 4 筆命中，除本次收錄 2 筆外其餘 2 筆已收錄。公司新聞面窗內無任何一手公開里程碑：Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL；Vico VO659 最新一手公告仍為 2026/02 的半年一次給藥世代與美國 IND 放行；Steminent／REPROCELL 仍為日本上市許可申請審查中；Arrowhead／Sarepta、安基、PTC、Larimar、Lexeo、Solid 窗內均無新公告。

en.body: Added 2 papers and 1 backfilled trial registration. (1) Backfilled trial: MOXIe (NCT02255435), the pivotal Phase 2 of omaveloxolone from Biogen (formerly Reata), surfaced by this scan because its registration was updated on 2026/09/03 and confirmed on comparison to be a record previously missing from the platform. It is the pivotal trial behind the only approved drug in the ataxia field (supporting the 2023 clearance of the world's first Friedreich's ataxia therapy), enrolling 172 participants across sites in the US, Australia, Austria, Italy and the UK, with results posted on 2022/11/29. Published readout (Lynch et al., Ann Neurol 2021): Part 2 randomised 103 patients and week-48 mFARS change was −1.55 on drug versus +0.85 on placebo, a between-group difference of −2.40 ± 0.96, p = 0.014, meeting the primary endpoint, with reversible aminotransferase elevations on safety. Note particularly that its registrational primary endpoint was mFARS, not SARA — a different scale from the SARA used by Steminent and by Kissei's rovatirelin, and the two should not be conflated when citing regulatory precedent. (2) Papers: (a) a Portuguese/German group in iScience proposes Importin-8 as a new therapeutic target in SCA3 (doi:10.1016/j.isci.2026.116446, online ahead of print 2026/08/26) — after screening 34 nucleocytoplasmic transport proteins they selected Ipo8, found its mRNA elevated in MJD/SCA3 models, and showed that knocking Ipo8 down reduces Ataxin-3 aggregation and neuronal dysfunction and alleviates ataxic traits in vivo, putatively via NF-κB/p65 and Argonaute-2. The route leaves ATXN3 itself untouched and instead alters where the mutant protein is trafficked, complementing the production-lowering approach of VO659 and ARO-ATXN2. (b) A Taiwanese group in J Tradit Complement Med reports a randomised, triple-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial of Astragalus membranaceus in SCA3 (doi:10.1016/j.jtcme.2026.06.002, September 2026 issue) — n=32 with 23 completers, showing a modest within-treatment fall in NfL (27.6 → 25.6 pg/mL, P = 0.040) and a rise in insulin (P = 0.004), but no significant between-treatment difference in NfL in the adjusted regression model (P = 0.127). It is recorded here as a caution on biomarker methodology (a textbook case of a significant within-group change alongside a non-significant between-group one; within-arm NfL movement cannot support an efficacy claim) and as a reference on local Taiwanese clinical capacity — not as any endorsement of efficacy. ⚠️ Limitations: (a) is entirely cell and mouse work, and Importin-8 has no clinical candidate, company or trial registration, with the safety of systemically inhibiting a broadly expressed nuclear import receptor unassessed; (b) has a negative primary analysis, a small sample and only three months of treatment, and Astragalus is not a tracked therapeutic competitor on this platform. Everything else found in this scan: across the five CT.gov indication queries (SCA, Friedreich's, SBMA, polyglutamine, episodic ataxia/CACNA1A), all other in-window changes were either already on file or excludable under §1b — Kissei NCT07040137, IntraBio NCT07221292, Biogen NCT06054893, Larimar NCT06447025 and NCT07778836, Lexeo NCT07721025, Solid NCT07180355, PTC NCT07681713 and Vico NCT05822908 are all on file and unchanged in status; Lexeo NCT06865482, FARA UNIFIED NCT06016946, Heidelberg TreatHSP NCT07798674, NINDS NCT00018889, NEI NCT02741440 and RISCA NCT01037777 are observational; NCT07743866 (temporal interference stimulation in SCA3, First Affiliated Hospital of Fujian Medical University) and NCT07752095 (cerebellar deep brain stimulation in SCA1/SCA3, Baltuch) are neuromodulation and excluded under §1b; the SBMA query remains flooded with prostate cancer trials exactly as the manual describes, and all four polyglutamine hits were already on file or long stale. PubMed returned 4 hits in the window, of which the 2 not added here were already on file. On the company news side there was no first-party public milestone in the window: Biohaven's troriluzole remains at the CRL of 2025-11-04; Vico's VO659 still has 2026/02 as its latest first-party announcement (the twice-yearly dosing cohort and US IND clearance); Steminent/REPROCELL remain under review for Japanese marketing authorisation; and Arrowhead/Sarepta, AnnJi, PTC, Larimar, Lexeo and Solid issued nothing in the window.

刷新登錄，狀態、收案數（85）、主要完成日（2027/01）皆未變動，僅確認納入範圍含未曾參與前期試驗、2 歲以上的兒童。⑤文獻：(a) 慶應義塾大學團隊在 Molecular Therapy 發表 AAV 補充 CBLN1 逆轉遺傳性共濟失調（doi:10.1016/j.ymthe.2026.09.003，2026/09/02）——在兩個家系發現雙等位基因 CBLN1 錯義變異（A63P、Y112C）造成早發型小腦共濟失調，建立敲入小鼠後對成年小鼠單次全身投予星形膠質細胞導向 AAV 即回復突觸功能、可塑性與行為，作者稱之為「可逆的小腦突觸病」；(b) 米蘭大學團隊在 J Huntingtons Dis 發表伴護蛋白輔助選擇性自噬（CASA）在多聚麩醯胺酸疾病的機轉綜論（doi:10.1177/18796397261478173，2026/09/03），整理 HSPB8–BAG3–HSPA–STUB1 複合體清除突變蛋白的代償與失能歷程，及藥理性自噬誘導等增強策略——代表 polyQ 領域「增強清除」路線，與 VO659、ARO-ATXN2 的「減少產生」路線互補。⚠️ 兩篇皆無人體療效資料：(a) 全為細胞與小鼠、且 CBLN1 屬隱性功能缺失型，機轉與 polyQ 毒性增益不同，可逆性結論不可外推至本社或 Vico 的適應症；(b) 為敘事型綜論、無合併效應值，舉例以 SBMA 與亨丁頓舞蹈症為主。本次其餘掃描結果：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich's／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）窗內其餘異動皆為已收錄或依 §1b 應排除者——Lexeo NCT06865482（FA 心肌病自然史）與 NCT07721025、FARA UNIFIED NCT06016946、海德堡 TreatHSP NCT07798674、NINDS NCT00018889 屬觀察性；福建醫科大學附屬第一醫院 NCT07743866（SCA3 顳葉干擾刺激）屬神經調節；SBMA 組一如手冊所載仍被前列腺癌試驗灌入。PubMed 兩組查詢窗內共 8 筆命中，除本次收錄 2 筆外，其餘或已收錄，或屬酵母 Med15 轉錄體、犬 ATP7A、CACNA1A 中長度等位基因 ALS-plus 個案報告等與追蹤資產無關之主題。公司新聞面窗內無任何一手公開里程碑：Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL；Steminent／REPROCELL 仍為日本上市許可申請審查中（2026/06/24 送件、PMDA 優先審查、目標九個月）；Vico VO659 最新一手公告仍為 en.body: ⚠️ Backfill note: the last successful publication was 2026/09/02; the scheduled runs for 09/03 and 09/04 did not execute, so this run covers all three days (09/03–09/05) — ClinicalTrials.gov by LastUpdatePostDate across that span, PubMed by a 4-to-6-day window. Added: two scientific papers, one new trial and three registry updates. ① New trial: Biogen's paediatric Phase 1 pharmacokinetics and safety study of omaveloxolone (BIIB141 / SKYCLARYS®), NCT06054893, in Friedreich's ataxia aged 2 to 15, now closed to enrolment with 33 participants actually enrolled and primary completion at 2030/06/04. This is the age-lowering path for the only approved drug in the ataxia field (currently approved for ages 16 and up): seven age cohorts stepping downward on single doses before moving to long-term dosing, with participation lasting up to 302 weeks and safety monitoring covering cardiac health and progression through puberty. It was a gap in this platform's records, and is a separate trial from Biogen's paediatric Ph3, NCT06953583. ② IntraBio's completion-date contradiction has been resolved by the sponsor: the pivotal study NCT07221292 (levacetylleucine in CACNA1A / SCA6 / EA2 / FHM1) posted an update on 2026/09/04 that brought primary completion forward sharply from 2028/08/01 to 2027/05/01, matching the company's 2026/08/19 statement that the trial is designed to finish about six months after enrolment closes — so where this site had been reporting two contradictory dates, it now follows 2027/05/01. Site statuses are unchanged (7 of 10 recruiting). ③ Kissei's third Ph3 of rovatirelin has completed enrolment: NCT07040137 was updated on 2026/09/04, moving from recruiting to ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, with n=142 and primary completion at 2027/03/31. This is the confirmatory study restarted after the Japanese application was withdrawn in 2023/07, and its primary endpoint — change in total SARA — is the same as Stemchymal®'s Phase 2 primary endpoint. The company has announced no topline date and this site does not speculate about one. ④ Larimar's nomlabofusp open-label extension, NCT06447025, refreshed its registry on 09/03 with no change to status, enrolment (85) or primary completion (2027/01); the record confirms it also enrols treatment-naive children aged 2 and older. ⑤ Papers: (a) a Keio University team reports in Molecular Therapy that AAV-mediated CBLN1 replacement rescues hereditary ataxia (doi:10.1016/j.ymthe.2026.09.003, 2026/09/02) — biallelic CBLN1 missense variants (A63P, Y112C) in two families cause early-onset cerebellar ataxia, and in a knock-in mouse a single systemic dose of an astrocyte-targeted AAV in adult animals restored synaptic function, plasticity and behaviour, which the authors describe as a reversible cerebellar synaptopathy; (b) a University of Milan team reviews chaperone-assisted selective autophagy (CASA) in polyglutamine disease in the Journal of Huntington's Disease (doi:10.1177/18796397261478173, 2026/09/03), tracing how the HSPB8–BAG3–HSPA–STUB1 complex clears mutant protein, how that compensation eventually fails, and what strategies — pharmacological autophagy inducers among them — might enhance it. This represents the "enhance clearance" route in polyQ, complementary to the "reduce production" route of VO659 and ARO-ATXN2. ⚠️ Neither paper carries human efficacy data: (a) is entirely cell and mouse work, and because CBLN1 ataxia is a recessive loss-of-function disorder rather than a polyglutamine toxic gain-of-function, its reversibility conclusion cannot be extrapolated to Steminent's or Vico's indications; (b) is a narrative review with no pooled effect estimates, worked mainly through SBMA and Huntington's disease. The rest of this scan: across the five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA / Friedreich's / SBMA / polyglutamine / episodic ataxia–CACNA1A), everything else that moved in the window was either already recorded or excluded under §1b — Lexeo's NCT06865482 (FA cardiomyopathy natural history) and NCT07721025, the FARA UNIFIED study NCT06016946, Heidelberg's TreatHSP platform NCT07798674 and NINDS's NCT00018889 are observational, while NCT07743866 (temporal interference stimulation for SCA3, First Affiliated Hospital of Fujian Medical University) is neuromodulation; the SBMA query remains flooded by prostate cancer trials exactly as the manual records. The two PubMed queries returned eight hits in the window; beyond the two recorded here, the rest were either already captured or concern subjects unrelated to the tracked assets — yeast Med15 transcriptomics, canine ATP7A, and an ALS-plus case report with an intermediate-length CACNA1A allele. On company news there were no primary public milestones in the window: Biohaven's troriluzole remains at the CRL of 2025-11-04; Steminent/REPROCELL remain under review on the Japanese marketing application (filed 2026/06/24, under PMDA priority review with a nine-month target); Vico's VO659 has issued nothing newer than 2026/02; and Arrowhead/Sarepta, AnnJi, PTC, Lexeo, Solid and Larimar issued nothing new.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻＋1 筆試驗登錄更新。①文獻：巴基斯坦 4 個無血緣家系、13 位痙攣—共濟失調重疊表現患者的分子診斷研究（Neurogenetics 27(1):63，真納大學 Ahmad R 等與 UCL Queen Square 之 Houlden H，doi:10.1007/s10048-026-00929-9，2026/08/31）。以全外顯子定序＋同型合子定位＋Sanger 驗證找出四個文獻已報告過的致病變異：CYP2U1（SPG56）、ATXN1 擴增 [(CAG)46/(CAG)27]（SCA1）、ATM（運動失調微血管擴張症）、COQ4（痙攣性共濟失調第 10 型）。收錄理由在第 2 家系：SCA1 正是 Vico VO659 與本社 Stemchymal® 多聚麩醯胺酸型適應症所涵蓋的亞型，先證者 48 歲／26 歲發病、(CAG)46，其子 21 歲／17 歲發病、(CAG)42，MRI 見小腦併全腦萎縮；所有 SCA 試驗皆以基因確診為納入條件，區域診斷能量與未來收案地圖相關。⚠️ 四個變異全屬已知、無新基因或新變異；樣本極小（4 家系／13 人）、單一族群、非代表性抽樣，不能推估盛行率；作者自陳未取得完整電生理與長期治療結果，且未做單體型分析、族源評估與族群頻率比較；不含任何藥物、療效或試驗資料，父子間 46→42 僅為個案觀察，不足以支持任何預期效應（anticipation）的量化推論。②試驗登錄更新：Lexeo LX2006 註冊型二期 NCT07721025（SUNRISE-FA 2）於 2026/09/02 更新登錄，首個臨床站點上線——南佛羅里達大學（Tampa, FL），目前登錄仍僅此 1 站，收案 26 人、主要完成日預估 2032/06。本日其餘掃描結果：ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich's／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）窗內無平台未收錄的療法型試驗——異動者為 NCT06865482（Lexeo 的 FA 心肌病自然史）、NCT06016946（FARA UNIFIED 自然史）、NCT07798674（海德堡大學 TreatHSP 平台）、NCT00018889（NINDS）、NCT06628687（Biogen omaveloxolone 孕哺期結果研究）、NCT07635030（費城兒童醫院 GABA/GSH 磁振頻譜）等觀察性研究，與 NCT07743866（福建醫科大學附屬第一醫院 SCA3 顳葉干擾刺激）神經調節研究，依 §1b 準則全數排除；SBMA 組仍如手冊所載被前列腺癌試驗灌入，其中真正的 SBMA 筆數（NINDS 生物標記觀察研究、武田 leuprorelin 用藥調查、Nido NIDO-361 Ph2）或屬觀察性、或已收錄。PubMed 窗內「spinocerebellar ataxia」標題／摘要查詢 5 筆、治療關鍵字查詢 4 筆，除本次收錄者外其餘皆已收錄。公司新聞面：Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL；Steminent／REPROCELL 仍為日本上市許可申請審查中；Vico VO659 最新一手公告仍為 2026/02；Arrowhead／Sarepta、安基、PTC、Larimar、Solid 窗內均無新的一手公開里程碑。

en.body: Added one scientific paper and one trial-registry update. ① Paper: a molecular-diagnostic study of four unrelated Pakistani families, 13 affected individuals across the overlapping spastic-ataxic spectrum (Neurogenetics 27(1):63; Ahmad R et al., Quaid-i-Azam University, with Houlden H at UCL Queen Square; doi:10.1007/s10048-026-00929-9; 2026/08/31). Exome sequencing, homozygosity mapping and Sanger confirmation identified four previously reported pathogenic variants: CYP2U1 (SPG56), an ATXN1 expansion [(CAG)46/(CAG)27] (SCA1), ATM (ataxia-telangiectasia) and COQ4 (spastic ataxia 10). It is here for the second family: SCA1 is exactly the subtype covered by Vico's VO659 and by Stemchymal®'s polyglutamine indication. The proband was 48, symptomatic from 26, carrying (CAG)46; his son 21, symptomatic from 17, carrying (CAG)42, with MRI showing cerebellar and generalised brain atrophy. Since every SCA trial requires genetic confirmation to enrol, regional diagnostic capacity bears on where future trials can recruit. ⚠️ All four variants were already known — no new gene, no new variant; the sample is very small (four families, 13 individuals), from a single population and not representative, so it supports no prevalence estimate; the authors state that electrophysiology and longitudinal therapeutic outcomes were unavailable and that haplotype analysis, ancestry assessment and population-frequency comparison were not performed; and the paper contains no drug, efficacy or trial data, the father-to-son 46→42 difference being a single observation that cannot support any quantitative inference about anticipation. ② Registry update: Lexeo's registrational Phase 2 of LX2006, NCT07721025 (SUNRISE-FA 2), posted an update on 2026/09/02 listing its first clinical site — the University of South Florida (Tampa, FL), still the only site on the record; enrolment is 26 with estimated primary completion 2032/06. The rest of today's scan: the five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA / Friedreich's / SBMA / polyglutamine / episodic ataxia–CACNA1A) surfaced no uncaptured therapeutic trials in the window. What moved was observational — NCT06865482 (Lexeo's FA cardiomyopathy natural history), NCT06016946 (the FARA UNIFIED natural history study), NCT07798674 (Heidelberg University's TreatHSP platform), NCT00018889 (NINDS), NCT06628687 (Biogen's omaveloxolone pregnancy and breastfeeding outcomes study) and NCT07635030 (GABA/GSH magnetic resonance spectroscopy at the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia) — plus NCT07743866, temporal interference stimulation for SCA3 at the First Affiliated Hospital of Fujian Medical University, which is neuromodulation; all were excluded under the §1b criteria. The SBMA query remains flooded by prostate cancer trials exactly as the manual records, and the genuine SBMA entries within it (the NINDS biomarker observational study, Takeda's leuprorelin drug-use survey, Nido's completed NIDO-361 Phase 2) are either observational or already recorded. PubMed returned five hits for "spinocerebellar ataxia" in title/abstract and four for the therapy-keyword query; all but the one added here were already recorded. On company news: Biohaven's troriluzole remains at the CRL of 2025-11-04; Steminent/REPROCELL remain under review on the Japanese marketing application; Vico's VO659 has issued nothing newer than 2026/02; and Arrowhead/Sarepta, AnnJi, PTC, Larimar and Solid posted no new primary public milestones in the window.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻：進行性小腦共濟失調的疾病進展預測——臨床、影像、體液、基因與數位五類生物標記的整備度綜論（Frontiers in Neurology 17:1921210，中國河南中醫藥大學第一附屬醫院腦病中心 Hao Y、Hao X，doi:10.3389/fneur.2026.1921210，電子版 2026/08/17）。作者的出發點是：ASO 與已核准的 omaveloxolone 正在進入臨床，使「可靠預測疾病進展」成為試驗成敗的核心障礙。五個領域的判讀：SARA 能捕捉基因型特異軌跡，但在病程兩端敏感度下降；體積／微結構／頻譜 MRI 與血液神經絲輕鏈（NfL）在發病前即已改變並具預測力；重複序列長度與基因修飾因子設定先驗風險；穿戴式感測器的步態與平衡指標比臨床量表更早偵測變化，並可大幅降低所需樣本數。作者主張沒有單一模態能滿足所有使用情境，應走向分期特異的多模態複合指標。收錄理由：本社 Stemchymal® 的 Ph2 主要終點即為 SARA，而 Biohaven troriluzole 的 CRL（2025/11）正是敗在真實世界證據與外部對照的設計問題——本文對終點選擇與收案分層有直接參考價值。⚠️ 綜論性質、非原始研究，無新數據、無合併效應值、不含任何療效或試驗結果；所提複合指標尚無前瞻性驗證。本日其餘掃描結果：ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich's／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）窗內無平台未收錄的療法型試驗——SCA 組異動者為 NCT07798674（海德堡大學 TreatHSP 共濟失調／痙攣性截癱自然史平台）、NCT00018889（NINDS 動作障礙表現型／基因型）、NCT02741440（NEI 的 SCA7 自然史）等觀察性研究，與 NCT07743866（福建醫科大學附屬第一醫院的 SCA3 顳葉干擾刺激）神經調節研究，依 §1b 準則全數排除；Larimar nomlabofusp Ph3 NCT07778836 與 IntraBio N-acetyl-L-leucine 樞紐試驗 NCT07221292 雖在窗內有登錄異動，但兩筆皆已收錄。PubMed 窗內 11 筆命中，除本次收錄者外，其餘或已收錄，或屬 ARSACS、SCA29、ataxia-telangiectasia、鉛神經毒性等與追蹤資產無關的主題。公司新聞面：Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL；Steminent／REPROCELL 仍為日本上市許可申請審查中；Vico VO659 最新一手公告仍為 2026/02 的半年一次給藥擴增世代與 FDA IND 放行；Arrowhead／Sarepta、安基、PTC、Lexeo、Solid 窗內均無新的一手公開里程碑。

en.body: Added one scientific paper: a review of progression prediction in progressive cerebellar ataxias, judging the readiness of clinical, imaging, fluid, genetic and digital biomarkers (Frontiers in Neurology 17:1921210; Hao Y, Hao X, Brain Disease Center, The First Affiliated Hospital, Henan University of Chinese Medicine, China; doi:10.3389/fneur.2026.1921210; e-published 2026/08/17). The authors' premise: with antisense oligonucleotides and the approved omaveloxolone now entering or reaching the clinic, reliable prediction of disease progression has become a central obstacle to trial success. Their verdicts across the five domains: SARA captures genotype-specific trajectories but loses sensitivity at the extremes of the disease course; volumetric, microstructural and spectroscopic MRI and blood neurofilament light chain change before onset and predict subsequent decline; repeat length and genetic modifiers set prior risk; and wearable-sensor gait and balance metrics detect change earlier than clinical scales and sharply reduce required sample sizes. They argue no single modality satisfies every context of use and press for stage-specific multimodal composites. Why it is here: Stemchymal®'s Phase 2 primary endpoint is SARA, and Biohaven's troriluzole CRL (2025/11) turned precisely on real-world-evidence and external-control design problems — so the review bears directly on endpoint selection and enrolment stratification. ⚠️ A review, not primary research: no new data, no pooled effect estimates, and no efficacy or trial results of any kind; the proposed composites are not prospectively validated. The rest of today's scan: the five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA / Friedreich's / SBMA / polyglutamine / episodic ataxia–CACNA1A) surfaced no uncaptured therapeutic trials in the window. What moved in the SCA query — NCT07798674 (Heidelberg University's TreatHSP adaptive natural-history platform for ataxias and hereditary spastic paraplegias), NCT00018889 (NINDS phenotype/genotype correlations in movement disorders) and NCT02741440 (NEI's SCA7 natural history) — is observational, and NCT07743866 (temporal interference stimulation for SCA3, First Affiliated Hospital of Fujian Medical University) is neuromodulation; all were excluded under the §1b criteria. Larimar's nomlabofusp Phase 3 NCT07778836 and IntraBio's pivotal N-acetyl-L-leucine study NCT07221292 both posted registry updates in the window but are already recorded. Of the 11 PubMed hits in the window, the rest were either already recorded or concern ARSACS, SCA29, ataxia-telangiectasia and lead neurotoxicity — subjects unrelated to the tracked assets. On company news: Biohaven's troriluzole remains at the CRL of 2025-11-04; Steminent/REPROCELL remain under review on the Japanese marketing application; Vico's VO659 has issued nothing newer than its 2026/02 announcement of twice-annual dosing in an expanded cohort and FDA clearance of its IND; and Arrowhead/Sarepta, AnnJi, PTC, Lexeo and Solid posted no new primary public milestones in the window.

body: 新增 2 則科學文獻＋1 筆補收試驗。①文獻：奈米孔 Cas9 標的定序（nCATS）＋STRiker 分析流程，單一次檢測涵蓋 56 個短串聯重複基因座，於 37 位「已做過廣泛基因檢測仍未確診」的小腦共濟失調病人中找出 12 人（32.4%）的致病性重複擴增，其中 FGF14（SCA27B）占 4 例（Advanced Science，韓國首爾大學醫院）。②文獻：類淋巴系統（glymphatic）功能失調在小腦神經退化中的角色綜論，聚焦 SCA3、MSA、PSP 與原發性顫抖症，機轉涵蓋 AQP4 極性錯置、神經發炎與睡眠相依體液動力學（Neurological Sciences）。③試驗：依手冊 §1b-2「已知資產點名查核」以藥名查詢補收 PTC Therapeutics 的 vatiquinone 長期開放標籤延伸試驗 NCT05515536（Ph3、實際收案 130 人、由前一個 vatiquinone 試驗直接轉入的 Friedreich's Ataxia 病人、14 站、完成日 2027/12/31）——先前的疾病條件查詢因排序與更新日之故未撈到；該試驗無安慰劑對照、不設盲，且登錄自 2025-10-30 起未再更新。本日另完成：ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich's／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）與 20 個資產的藥名點名查核，除上述一筆外未見其他未收錄的療法型試驗；競品新聞掃描（仲恩、Biohaven、Vico、Arrowhead）近 7 天內無新發布。

en.body: Added 2 papers and 1 back-filled trial. ①Paper: nanopore Cas9-targeted sequencing (nCATS) with the STRiker analysis workflow, covering 56 short tandem repeat loci in a single test, identified pathogenic repeat expansions in 12 of 37 (32.4%) cerebellar ataxia patients who had remained undiagnosed despite extensive prior genetic testing, with FGF14 (SCA27B) accounting for 4 cases (Advanced Science, Seoul National University Hospital, South Korea). ②Paper: a review of glymphatic dysfunction in cerebellar neurodegeneration, focused on SCA3, MSA, PSP and essential tremor, covering AQP4 mispolarisation, neuroinflammation and sleep-dependent fluid dynamics (Neurological Sciences). ③Trial: the drug-name roll call in §1b-2 of the operating manual back-filled PTC Therapeutics' long-term open-label vatiquinone extension NCT05515536 (Ph3, 130 actually enrolled, Friedreich's ataxia patients rolling over directly from a previous vatiquinone study, 14 sites, completion date 2027/12/31) — the disease-condition queries had missed it because of its sort position and last-update date; the trial has no placebo control, is unmasked, and its registry entry has not been updated since 2025-10-30. Also completed today: all five ClinicalTrials.gov indication queries (SCA / Friedreich's / SBMA / polyglutamine / episodic ataxia–CACNA1A) and the drug-name roll call across 20 assets, which surfaced no other uncaptured therapeutic trials; the competitor news sweep (Steminent, Biohaven, Vico, Arrowhead) found no releases in the past 7 days.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻＋1 家競品（含 1 筆試驗）。①文獻：輕至中度 SCA2 病人的血糖恆定未受破壞（Cerebellum，古巴 Holguín 遺傳性共濟失調研究與復健中心 CIRAH，Aguilera-Rodríguez R 等、通訊作者 Almaguer-Mederos LE，合作單位含英國 UCL Queen Square 神經學研究所，doi:10.1007/s12311-026-02076-1）。這是一篇陰性結果的原始研究：收案 SCA2 病人 79 例、對照 83 例，其中病人 20 例／對照 19 例另做口服葡萄糖耐受試驗；SCA2 雖已知同時有小腦葡萄糖代謝低下、全身代謝亢進與體重下降，作者結論為「輕至中度共濟失調的 SCA2 病人並無重大血糖恆定異常」，血糖指標與身體組成僅弱至中度相關、對疾病嚴重度僅有名目效應。收錄理由：ATXN2 正是 Arrowhead ARO-ATXN2 的標的（SCA2 siRNA，Ph1 NCT06672445，含台北榮總站點），本篇縮小了血糖指標作為 SCA2 進展／藥效生物標記的空間。⚠️ 單一族群、橫斷面、OGTT 子群僅約 20 人、僅涵蓋輕至中度病人，無任何治療或試驗資料。②競品補收（主動發現，屬既有覆蓋缺口）：Biogen 的 omaveloxolone（SKYCLARYS®／BIIB141）先前完全未被平台收錄，今日補入 competitors.json（ring: ataxia）、companies.json 與其兒童 Ph3 NCT06953583。此藥 2023/02 獲 FDA 核准、2024/02/12 獲歐盟核准，適應症為 ≥16 歲 Friedreich's Ataxia，是共濟失調領域第一個也是目前唯一獲准的藥物（原 Reata 開發、後由 Biogen 收購）；新 Ph3 於 2025/06/09 起始、n≈255、2–15 歲、33 站橫跨 16 國、主要完成日 2027/11/16、登錄最後更新 2026-06-16。補收的價值在於它是「共濟失調適應症走完 FDA／EMA 全程」的唯一先例，與 Biohaven troriluzole（2025/11 CRL）、PTC vatiquinone（2025/08 CRL）形成法規可行性的直接對照。⚠️ 適應症為 FA、非 SCA，不與本社直接競爭；兒童 Ph3 尚無任何療效或安全性結果公開讀出。③一併修正別名：原「Biogen／Ionis」（BIIB132 ATXN3 ASO，2023 已放棄）的 match 含裸字「Biogen」，會把新收的 omaveloxolone FA 試驗誤掛到 ASO 專案的公司卡上，已收窄為「Biogen / Ionis」，BIIB132／ION260 別名不受影響。本次掃描的其餘結果：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢中，SCA 組窗內異動者（NCT02741440 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史、NCT00018889 NINDS 動作障礙表現型／基因型、NCT01037777 RISCA、NCT07752095 與 NCT07288437 等深部腦刺激、NCT07743866 顳葉干擾刺激）依 §1b 準則屬觀察性或神經調節，全數排除；Friedreich 組另見 NCT06628687（Biogen omaveloxolone 孕期／哺乳期暴露登錄）屬上市後觀察性登錄，依準則不收；polyglutamine、SBMA、episodic ataxia／CACNA1A 三組窗內無新案（SBMA 組命中仍以前列腺癌為主，已逐筆排除）。PubMed 窗內除本次收錄者外均已收錄。公司新聞面：Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL；Steminent／REPROCELL 仍為日本上市許可申請審查中；Vico、Arrowhead／Sarepta、安基、Larimar、IntraBio、Lexeo、Solid 窗內無新的一手公開里程碑。

en.body: Added one scientific paper and one competitor (with one trial). ① Paper: blood glucose homeostasis is preserved in mild-to-moderate SCA2 (Cerebellum; Aguilera-Rodríguez R et al., corresponding author Almaguer-Mederos LE, Center for the Investigation and Rehabilitation of Hereditary Ataxias, CIRAH, Holguín, Cuba, with UCL Queen Square Institute of Neurology, UK; doi:10.1007/s12311-026-02076-1). This is a primary study reporting a negative result: 79 SCA2 patients and 83 controls, of whom 20 patients and 19 controls also underwent an oral glucose tolerance test. Although SCA2 is known to combine cerebellar glucose hypometabolism, systemic hypermetabolism and weight loss, the authors conclude that patients with mild-to-moderate SCA2 ataxia have no major alteration in blood glucose homeostasis; glucose markers correlated only weakly to moderately with body composition and had only nominal effects on disease severity. Why it is here: ATXN2 is the target of Arrowhead's ARO-ATXN2 (siRNA for SCA2, Phase 1 NCT06672445, with a site at Taipei Veterans General Hospital), and the paper narrows the space for glucose measures as a progression or pharmacodynamic biomarker in SCA2. ⚠️ A single population, cross-sectional design, an OGTT subgroup of only about 20, mild-to-moderate patients only, and no treatment or trial data of any kind. ② Competitor added (proactive discovery; an existing coverage gap): Biogen's omaveloxolone (SKYCLARYS® / BIIB141) had not been recorded on this platform at all and was added today to competitors.json (ring: ataxia), companies.json and, as a trial, its paediatric Phase 3 NCT06953583. The drug was approved by the FDA in 2023/02 and by the European Commission on 2024/02/12 for Friedreich's ataxia in patients aged 16 and over, making it the first and so far only approved therapy in the ataxia field (originally developed by Reata, later acquired by Biogen). The new Phase 3 started 2025/06/09 with n≈255 aged 2–15 across 33 sites in 16 countries, primary completion 2027/11/16, registry last updated 2026-06-16. The value of adding it is that it is the single precedent of an ataxia indication completing the full FDA/EMA route, a direct regulatory-feasibility counterpoint to Biohaven's troriluzole (CRL 2025/11) and PTC's vatiquinone (CRL 2025/08). ⚠️ The indication is FA, not SCA, so it does not compete directly with Steminent, and the paediatric Phase 3 has no publicly reported efficacy or safety results. ③ Alias correction made alongside: the existing 'Biogen / Ionis' entry (BIIB132, an ATXN3 ASO abandoned in 2023) carried a bare 'Biogen' in its match list, which would have attached the newly added omaveloxolone FA trial to the ASO programme's company card; it has been narrowed to 'Biogen / Ionis', leaving the BIIB132 and ION260 aliases untouched. The rest of the scan: across the five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries, everything that moved in the SCA window — NCT02741440 (NEI's SCA7 natural history), NCT00018889 (NINDS phenotype/genotype correlations in movement disorders), NCT01037777 (RISCA), the deep brain stimulation studies NCT07752095 and NCT07288437, and NCT07743866 (temporal interference stimulation) — is observational or neuromodulation and was excluded under the §1b criteria. The Friedreich query also surfaced NCT06628687 (Biogen's omaveloxolone pregnancy and breastfeeding exposure registry), a post-marketing observational registry and therefore not recorded. The polyglutamine, SBMA and episodic ataxia/CACNA1A queries returned nothing new in the window (the SBMA query again returned mostly prostate-cancer trials, excluded one by one). Every PubMed hit in the window apart from the paper added here was already recorded. On company news: Biohaven's troriluzole remains at the CRL of 2025-11-04; Steminent/REPROCELL remain under review on the Japanese marketing application; and Vico, Arrowhead/Sarepta, AnnJi, Larimar, IntraBio, Lexeo and Solid posted no new primary public milestones in the window.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻：ATXN2 的遺傳複雜度超出顯性框架（Neurol Genet 12(5):e200428，瑞典卡羅林斯卡學院 Laffita-Mesa JM、Paucar M、Svenningsson P，doi:10.1212/NXG.0000000000200428）。本篇為評論／分析文章、非原始研究，係針對 Saucier 等人報告的一個阿卡迪亞家系呈現隱性遺傳型 ATXN2 相關疾病所寫。作者指出 ATXN2 最初被歸為顯性 SCA2 致病基因、其 CAG 擴增後又成為 ALS 的主要風險因子，而該隱性家系挑戰了「ATXN2 疾病主由顯性功能獲得驅動」的長期假設；並主張遺傳模式可能因重複序列插斷、體細胞鑲嵌、基因劑量三項因素而改變，功能喪失機轉在特定情境下亦參與致病，因此疾病分類、遺傳諮詢與治療策略都需要基因型分層。收錄理由：ATXN2 正是 Arrowhead ARO-ATXN2 的標的（SCA2 siRNA，Ph1 NCT06672445，含台北榮總站點）——若部分病人是以功能喪失致病，「降低 ATXN2 表現量」的策略在那些族群未必成立。⚠️ 立論基礎為單一家系，無族群層級頻率數據、無任何療效或試驗資料，功能喪失致病屬作者假說而非已證實結論；另註明 Biogen／Ionis BIIB105（ION541）為 ATXN2／ALS 案、非 SCA 案，不可混用。本次掃描的其餘結果：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢無平台未收錄的新療法試驗——SCA 組窗內異動的 NCT02741440（美國 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史）與 NCT00018889（NINDS 動作障礙表現型／基因型相關性研究）皆屬觀察性研究，依 §1b 準則排除；Friedreich、polyglutamine、SBMA、episodic ataxia／CACNA1A 四組窗內均無新案（最新命中 NCT07778836、NCT07180355、NCT07221292 皆已收錄，SBMA 組命中仍以前列腺癌試驗為主、已逐筆排除）。PubMed 窗內 2 筆命中，除本次收錄者外 PMID 42653351 已收錄。公司新聞面：Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL；Steminent／REPROCELL 仍為 2026-06-24 日本上市許可申請審查中、美國 Ph2 首例收案預計 2026-09 前完成；Vico、Arrowhead／Sarepta、安基、PTC、Larimar、IntraBio、Lexeo、Solid 窗內均無新的公開里程碑。

en.body: Added 1 scientific paper: the genetic complexity of ATXN2 reaches beyond a dominant framework (Neurol Genet 12(5):e200428; Laffita-Mesa JM, Paucar M, Svenningsson P, Karolinska Institutet, Sweden; doi:10.1212/NXG.0000000000200428). The piece is a commentary, not primary research, written around Saucier et al.'s report of an Acadian family showing a recessive inheritance pattern of ATXN2-related disease. The authors note that ATXN2 was first tied to dominant SCA2 and that its CAG expansions later emerged as a major risk factor for ALS, and that this recessive family challenges the long-held assumption that ATXN2 disease is driven predominantly by dominant gain-of-function. They argue the mode of inheritance may shift with repeat interruptions, somatic mosaicism and gene dosage, that loss-of-function mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis in certain contexts, and that disease classification, genetic counselling and therapeutic strategy therefore all require genetic stratification. Why it is here: ATXN2 is exactly the target of Arrowhead's ARO-ATXN2 (siRNA for SCA2, Phase 1 NCT06672445, with a site at Taipei Veterans General Hospital) — if some patients are driven by loss of function, lowering ATXN2 expression does not necessarily hold for them. ⚠️ The argument rests on a single family, with no population-level frequency data and no efficacy or trial data, and loss-of-function pathogenesis is the authors' hypothesis rather than an established conclusion; note too that Biogen/Ionis' BIIB105 (ION541) is an ATXN2/ALS programme, not an SCA one. Everything else this scan turned up: the five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries surfaced no therapeutic trials the platform does not already hold — the two SCA-query records that moved in the window, NCT02741440 (NEI's SCA7 natural history) and NCT00018889 (NINDS phenotype/genotype correlations in movement disorders), are observational studies and were excluded under the §1b criteria; the Friedreich, polyglutamine, SBMA and episodic ataxia/CACNA1A queries returned nothing new in the window (the most recent hits, NCT07778836, NCT07180355 and NCT07221292, are all already recorded, and the SBMA query again returned mostly prostate-cancer trials, excluded one by one). PubMed returned 2 hits in the window; apart from the one added here, PMID 42653351 was already recorded. On company news: Biohaven's troriluzole remains where it stood at the CRL of 2025-11-04; Steminent/REPROCELL remain under review on the Japanese marketing application filed 2026-06-24, with first-patient enrolment in the US Phase 2 expected by 2026-09; and Vico, Arrowhead/Sarepta, AnnJi, PTC, Larimar, IntraBio, Lexeo and Solid posted no new public milestones in the window.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻：長讀定序解出隱性 SCA（SCAR29／VPS41）（Mol Genet Genomic Med，日本名古屋大學等 11 單位聯合，通訊作者 Ogi T）——一名 24 歲患者短讀定序無法定案，改以長讀定序加 RNA 分析後確認為 VPS41 雙等位基因變異所致的 SCAR29，機轉為兩個等位基因各自造成互補的剪接缺陷而使 VPS41 表現量下降。收錄理由是其方法學意涵：常規短讀定序會漏掉的剪接層次變異需長讀定序才解得出，對以基因型分層收案的 SCA 試驗是篩選端的提醒。⚠️ 屬 n＝1 病例報告、無療效內容；SCAR29 為體染色體隱性、VPS41 功能喪失，與仲恩 Stemchymal 所針對的 polyQ 顯性 SCA 完全不同類，不可外推。本次掃描的其餘結果：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢無平台未收錄的新療法試驗——SCA 組窗內兩筆異動（NCT02741440 美國 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史、NCT00018889 NINDS 的動作障礙表現型／基因型相關性研究，均 08/28 更新）皆屬觀察性研究，依 §1b 準則排除；另窗內 NCT07752095（小腦深部腦刺激於 SCA1／SCA3）屬神經調節、同準則排除。Friedreich、polyglutamine、SBMA、episodic ataxia／CACNA1A 四組窗內均無新案（最新命中 NCT07778836 08/21、NCT07180355 08/17、NCT07221292 08/20 皆已收錄；SBMA 組命中仍以前列腺癌試驗為主，已逐筆排除）。PubMed 窗內 3 筆命中，除本次收錄者外，PMID 42640356 已收錄、PMID 42651197（鉛對神經細胞的氧化壓力毒性）與 SCA 無關而排除。公司新聞面：Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL 與 2026-03 撤回 EMA 申請；Steminent、Vico、Arrowhead／Sarepta、安基、PTC、Larimar、IntraBio 窗內無新的一手公開新聞稿（IntraBio 的 PDUFA 2026-09-19 為平台既有紀錄）。

en.body: One new paper added: long-read sequencing resolves a recessive SCA (SCAR29 / VPS41) (Mol Genet Genomic Med; a collaboration across 11 Japanese institutions including Nagoya University, corresponding author Ogi T). A 24-year-old patient went undiagnosed on short-read sequencing; long-read sequencing combined with RNA analysis established the cause as biallelic VPS41 variants giving rise to SCAR29, the mechanism being complementary splicing defects on the two alleles that together reduce VPS41 expression. It was included for its methodological implication: splice-level variants that routine short-read sequencing misses need long-read sequencing to resolve, which matters at the screening end of any SCA trial that stratifies enrolment by genotype. ⚠️ It is an n = 1 case report with no therapeutic content, and SCAR29 — autosomal recessive, driven by loss of VPS41 function — is an entirely different class from the dominant polyQ SCAs Stemchymal targets, so nothing extrapolates. The rest of the scan: the five ClinicalTrials.gov indication queries surfaced no therapeutic trial not already recorded here. Two records changed in the SCA query (NCT02741440, the US National Eye Institute's SCA7 natural history study, and NCT00018889, the NINDS phenotype/genotype correlation study in movement disorders, both updated 08/28) and both are observational, excluded under the §1b criteria; NCT07752095 (cerebellar deep brain stimulation in SCA1 and SCA3) is neuromodulation and excluded on the same basis. The Friedreich, polyglutamine, SBMA and episodic ataxia / CACNA1A queries returned nothing new in the window — the most recent hits, NCT07778836 (08/21), NCT07180355 (08/17) and NCT07221292 (08/20), are all already recorded, and the SBMA query continues to return mostly prostate cancer trials, excluded case by case. PubMed returned three hits: besides the one added, PMID 42640356 was already recorded and PMID 42651197 (lead toxicity and oxidative stress in neuronal cells) was excluded as unrelated to SCA. On the news side, Biohaven's troriluzole remains where it stood at the CRL of 2025-11-04 and the March 2026 withdrawal of its EMA application; Steminent, Vico, Arrowhead/Sarepta, AnnJi, PTC, Larimar and IntraBio issued no new primary press release within the window (IntraBio's PDUFA date of 2026-09-19 is already recorded here).

body: 本次為補掃：上次成功發布為 2026-08-25，08-26 當日排程未執行，故本次一併回補 08-26～08-27 兩天的窗期（PubMed 以 reldate=4 拉長、CT.gov 以 LastUpdatePostDate 範圍檢視）。新增 1 則科學文獻：共濟失調微血管擴張症（A-T）療法進展綜述（Int J Mol Sci，2026/08/17，澳洲 Nayler／Lavin／Coman 等；Lavin MF 為 ATM 基因原始發現者之一）——盤點 A-T 目前各條治療路線：粒線體支持與抗發炎、基因治療、突變特異性 ASO、多系統症狀的小分子；並指出基因治療的關鍵瓶頸在於 ATM 基因過大（cDNA 約 9.2 kb），超出 AAV 約 4.7 kb 的包裝上限。收錄理由是 A-T 屬平台的鄰近共濟失調圈層，且平台已追蹤三條相關資產（IntraBio levacetylleucine A-T sNDA、PDUFA 2026-09-19；Quince EryDex；Timothy Yu 的 ASO NCT07215416）。⚠️ 屬綜述、無新療效數字，且 A-T 不是 polyQ 疾病，與仲恩 Stemchymal 所針對的 polyQ SCA 無直接機轉關聯。本次掃描的其餘結果：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢在窗內無平台未收錄的新療法試驗——SCA 組窗內唯一異動為 NCT02741440（美國國家眼科研究所 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史研究，08/27 更新），屬觀察性自然史研究，依 §1b 準則排除；Friedreich、polyglutamine、episodic ataxia／CACNA1A 三組窗內無新案（最新命中 NCT07778836 08/21、NCT07221292 08/20，皆已收錄）；SBMA 組窗內唯一異動 NCT04090528 為前列腺癌試驗，依準則排除。另以註冊日排序做 §1b 廣掃，前 25 筆的療法型試驗全數已在 trials.json。PubMed 窗內僅此 1 筆命中。公司新聞面：Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL；REPROCELL 的日本查驗登記（2026-06）、IntraBio 的 PDUFA 日期均為平台既有紀錄，窗內未見新事實；Steminent、Vico、Arrowhead、安基、PTC、Larimar 等窗內無新公開新聞稿。

en.body: This scan is a catch-up. The last successful publication was 2026-08-25 and the scheduled run did not execute on 08-26, so this pass covers the 08-26 to 08-27 window in one go (PubMed widened via reldate=4, ClinicalTrials.gov reviewed across the LastUpdatePostDate range). One paper added: a review of recent therapeutic advances in ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T) (Int J Mol Sci, 2026/08/17, Nayler / Lavin / Coman et al., Australia; Lavin MF was among those who originally identified the ATM gene). It surveys the routes currently pursued in A-T — mitochondrial support and anti-inflammatory strategies, gene therapy, mutation-targeted ASOs, and small molecules for the multi-system features — and identifies the central bottleneck for gene therapy as the size of the ATM gene itself (cDNA around 9.2 kb), which exceeds AAV's packaging limit of roughly 4.7 kb. It was included because A-T sits in the platform's adjacent ataxia ring and three related assets are already tracked here (IntraBio's levacetylleucine A-T sNDA with a PDUFA date of 2026-09-19; Quince's EryDex; and Timothy Yu's ASO, NCT07215416). ⚠️ It is a review carrying no new efficacy figures, and A-T is not a polyQ disease — there is no direct mechanistic link to the polyQ SCAs that Steminent's Stemchymal targets. Remaining coverage of this scan: none of the five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned a therapeutic trial in the window not already held by the platform. The only change in the SCA set was NCT02741440, the National Eye Institute's SCA7 natural history study (updated 08/27), an observational natural history study excluded under the section 1b criteria; the Friedreich, polyglutamine and episodic ataxia/CACNA1A sets returned nothing new in the window (their leading hits, NCT07778836 of 08/21 and NCT07221292 of 08/20, are both already covered); and the sole change in the SBMA set, NCT04090528, is a prostate cancer trial and was excluded. A separate section 1b sweep sorted by registration date found that every therapeutic trial among the newest 25 is already in trials.json. PubMed returned this single hit for the window. On the corporate news side, Biohaven's troriluzole remains where it was at the 2025-11-04 Complete Response Letter; REPROCELL's Japanese marketing application (2026-06) and IntraBio's PDUFA date are both existing platform records with no new facts in the window; and no new public press releases were found for Steminent, Vico, Arrowhead, AnnJi, PTC or Larimar.

body: 新增 2 則科學文獻：① 默沙東（Merck & Co.）的 ATXN2 剪接調控 ASO（Neurobiol Dis，2026/08/24）——找出 ATXN2 內含子 8 的替代 5' 剪接位，以 ASO 促進該剪接造成框移、藉此降低 Ataxin-2 蛋白，於人類細胞模型減少 TDP-43 聚集與壓力顆粒、於 rNLS8 小鼠改善 TDP-43 病理。ATXN2 正是 SCA2 致病基因、也是 Arrowhead ARO-ATXN2（siRNA、Ph1 NCT06672445）的標的，顯示大藥廠亦投入 Ataxin-2 降解、但採剪接調控 ASO 而非 RNAi。⚠️ 本案適應症是 ALS 不是 SCA2，且停在臨床前，默沙東未公開任何 SCA2／共濟失調開發計畫，未據此新增競品。② 332 顆大腦的小腦退化屍檢比較（Cerebellum，2026/08/25，UT Southwestern／哥倫比亞大學）——原發性顫抖症 178、SCA 56、Friedreich's ataxia 13、對照 85；浦金氏細胞線性密度與空籃比例在所有組別（含對照）皆顯著負相關但強度各異，籃狀細胞叢評級僅在部分疾病相關。⚠️ 摘要未細分 SCA 亞型、亦未區分 polyQ 與非 polyQ，且屬死後神經病理、非臨床療效終點。本次掃描的其餘結果：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢窗內均無平台未收錄的新療法試驗——SCA 組最新命中為 NCT07778836（08/21）、NCT07221292（08/20），皆已收錄；Friedreich、polyglutamine、episodic ataxia／CACNA1A 三組無新案；SBMA 組一如既往由前列腺癌與 SMA 的字面命中主導，依準則排除。PubMed 近 4–5 天另有 3 筆命中，逐筆檢視後不予收錄（SCYL1 嬰兒肝衰竭病例報告、亨丁頓舞蹈症初級纖毛機轉綜述、GDAP2 相關 SCA 單一病例報告），均非 polyQ／SCA 療法進展。Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL；Steminent、Vico、Arrowhead、IntraBio、PTC 等在窗內未見新公開新聞稿。

en.body: Two papers added. (i) A splice-modulating ASO against ATXN2 from Merck & Co. (Neurobiol Dis, 2026/08/24) — the team identified an alternative 5' splice site in intron 8 of ATXN2 and used ASOs to promote that splicing, producing a frameshift that lowers Ataxin-2 protein; this reduced TDP-43 aggregation and stress granule formation in human cell models and ameliorated TDP-43 pathology in rNLS8 mice. ATXN2 is the causative gene in SCA2 and the target of Arrowhead's ARO-ATXN2 (siRNA, Phase 1, NCT06672445), so large pharma is working on Ataxin-2 lowering too, though via splice modulation rather than RNAi. ⚠️ The indication here is ALS, not SCA2, and the work is preclinical; Merck has disclosed no SCA2 or ataxia programme, so no competitor entry was added on this basis. (ii) A comparative postmortem study of 332 brains in cerebellar degeneration (Cerebellum, 2026/08/25, UT Southwestern / Columbia) — 178 essential tremor, 56 SCA, 13 Friedreich's ataxia and 85 controls; Purkinje cell linear density correlated negatively with the percentage of empty baskets in every group including controls, though to differing degrees, while basket plexus rating was associated with the other metrics only in some diseases. ⚠️ The abstract gives no SCA subtype breakdown and does not separate polyQ from non-polyQ forms, and this is postmortem neuropathology rather than a clinical efficacy endpoint. Remaining coverage of this scan: none of the five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned a therapeutic trial in the window that the platform did not already hold — the leading SCA hits NCT07778836 (08/21) and NCT07221292 (08/20) are both already covered; the Friedreich, polyglutamine and episodic ataxia/CACNA1A sets returned nothing new; and the SBMA set was once again dominated by prostate cancer and SMA studies matching on the word 'atrophy', excluded under the criteria. PubMed returned three further hits over the last 4–5 days, all reviewed and excluded (a SCYL1 infantile liver failure case report, a review of primary cilium dysfunction in Huntington's disease, and a single case report of GDAP2-related SCA), none of them an advance in polyQ or SCA therapy. Biohaven's troriluzole remains where it was at the 2025-11-04 CRL, and no new public press releases were found for Steminent, Vico, Arrowhead, IntraBio or PTC within the window.
