body: 本週的既有資產「點名查核」補到平台上線以來最重要的一次漏收：IntraBio 的 A-T 樞紐三期與其 2026/09/19 的 PDUFA 行動日，整條線先前完全不在平台上。（1）新增競品試驗 3 筆。① IB1001-303／NCT06673056（IntraBio，levacetylleucine 用於毛細血管擴張性共濟失調 A-T）：Ph3 樞紐、隨機雙盲安慰劑對照交叉、n=60、4 歲以上基因確診、合格條件 SARA 7–34，主要指標即 SARA（第 12 週 vs 第 24 週），次要含 SCAFI／ICARS／CGI／EQ-5D／NeuroQOL-UEF，11 站（美 3、德 2、斯洛伐克 2、西 1、瑞 1、英 2），實際起始 2025/03/18、狀態已收案完畢。公司宣稱達主要指標與全部關鍵次要指標，並據以於 2026/05/19 獲 FDA 受理 sNDA 併優先審查、PDUFA 行動日 2026/09/19，2026/06 另送 EMA 變更申請；若獲准將是 A-T 全球第一個核准療法。② NCT05243017（uniQure AMT-130 歐洲平行試驗，Ph1b/2、n=14、早期顯性亨丁頓舞蹈症），補上與已收錄美國試驗 NCT04120493 同資產的另一地登錄。③ NCT05445323（Lexeo LX2006 首次人體 Ph1/2、n=8、FA 心肌病變），為已收錄 Ph2 試驗 NCT07721025 的前身資料來源。（2）新增結果讀出 1 筆與競品動態 1 則，並更新 IntraBio 的競品全景列與公司情報卡（適應症、期別、狀態、pipeline、insight、updates 全面改寫）。會議雷達另補收 ICAR 2026（International Congress for Ataxia Research，2026/11/10–13、美國亞特蘭大，NAF／FARA／AGI／Ataxia UK 四方共同主辦）——共濟失調領域最重要的專門研究大會先前竟不在雷達上；NAF 年會 2027 屆日期官網尚未公布，維持待公布。為什麼這筆重要：這將是共濟失調圈層第一個以 SARA 為註冊主要指標走完 FDA 審查的案子——獲准即替「SARA 可作為註冊終點」建立監管先例，對本社同樣以 SARA 為主要指標的開發路徑屬有利背書；反面則是同一分子的 IB1001-304 明列 SCA6、與本社日本申請適應症正面重疊，A-T 先行核准會讓其在共濟失調醫師社群的熟悉度與給付路徑領先本社。⚠️ 公司迄今未公開任何數值、p 值或效果量，「高度統計顯著」屬公司自述、無同儕審閱資料；且 NCT06673056 登錄自 2025-07-03 起未再更新，其登錄主要完成日 2027/12/31 已與申請進度脫節，不可當成現況。另公司新聞稿稱收案 2025/05 啟動、不到兩個月超額達 167%、10 站，與登錄之起始日與站數略有出入，本站兩者並列不擇一。（3）本次掃描的其餘結果：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢窗內均無平台未收錄的新療法試驗（SCA 組前列命中 NCT07778836、NCT07221292 皆已收錄；Friedreich、SBMA、polyglutamine、episodic ataxia／CACNA1A 四組無新案，SBMA 組一如既往多為前列腺癌與 SMA 的字面命中，依準則排除）。PubMed 近 4–7 天命中 5 筆，逐筆檢視後全數不予收錄：SCYL1 嬰兒肝衰竭病例報告、GeneReviews 的 SAMD9L 章節改版、GDAP2 相關 SCA 單一病例報告、抗 GAD 自體免疫小腦失調病例報告與系統性回顧，皆非 polyQ／SCA 療法進展。Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL、無新進展；Steminent、Vico、Arrowhead、PTC 等在窗內未見新公開新聞稿。

en.body: This week's roll-call of existing assets caught the most consequential omission since the platform launched: IntraBio's A-T pivotal Phase 3 and its PDUFA action date of 2026/09/19 were entirely absent from the platform. (1) Three competitor trials added. (i) IB1001-303 / NCT06673056 (IntraBio, levacetylleucine in ataxia-telangiectasia, A-T): pivotal Phase 3, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover, n=60, genetically confirmed patients aged 4 and over, eligibility requiring SARA 7–34, with SARA as the primary endpoint (week 12 versus week 24) and SCAFI, ICARS, CGI, EQ-5D and NeuroQOL-UEF among the secondaries, across 11 sites (3 US, 2 German, 2 Slovak, 1 Spanish, 1 Swiss, 2 UK), actual start 2025/03/18, enrolment now complete. The company states it met the primary endpoint and all key secondary endpoints, and on that basis the FDA accepted an sNDA with Priority Review on 2026/05/19, setting a PDUFA action date of 2026/09/19, with a variation application submitted to the EMA in 2026/06; approval would make it the first approved therapy for A-T anywhere. (ii) NCT05243017 (uniQure's European AMT-130 study, Ph1b/2, n=14, early manifest Huntington's disease), the companion registration to the US trial NCT04120493 already covered. (iii) NCT05445323 (Lexeo's first-in-human LX2006 Ph1/2, n=8, FA cardiomyopathy), the source of the data underpinning the Phase 2 trial NCT07721025 already covered. (2) One results readout and one competitor-news item added, and IntraBio's competitor-landscape row and company profile were rewritten throughout (indication, phase, status, pipeline, insight and updates). The conference radar also gained ICAR 2026 (the International Congress for Ataxia Research, 2026/11/10–13 in Atlanta, hosted jointly by NAF, FARA, the AGI and Ataxia UK) — the field's most important dedicated research congress had somehow been missing from the radar; the NAF annual conference's 2027 dates are not yet posted on its site, so that entry stays as to-be-announced. Why this matters: it would be the first programme in the ataxia ring to complete FDA review with SARA as its registrational primary endpoint — approval would establish the precedent that SARA can serve as a registrational endpoint, favourable external validation for our own SARA-based development path. The other side is that the same molecule's IB1001-304 explicitly lists SCA6, overlapping the indication in our Japan filing directly, and an A-T approval first would put it ahead of us in physician familiarity and reimbursement pathway across the ataxia community. ⚠️ The company has released no numbers, p-values or effect sizes to date; 'high statistical significance' is its own characterisation with no peer-reviewed data behind it. And NCT06673056 has not been updated since 2025-07-03, so its registered primary completion date of 2027/12/31 is out of step with the filing and should not be read as current. The company's press release also puts enrolment as opening in 2025/05, over-enrolling to 167% in under two months across 10 sites, which differs slightly from the registered start date and site count; both are reported here rather than choosing between them. (3) Remaining coverage of this scan: none of the five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned a therapeutic trial in the window that the platform did not already hold (the leading SCA hits NCT07778836 and NCT07221292 are both already covered; the Friedreich, SBMA, polyglutamine and episodic ataxia/CACNA1A sets returned nothing new, with the SBMA set once again dominated by prostate cancer and SMA studies matching on the word 'atrophy', excluded under the criteria). PubMed returned 5 hits over the last 4–7 days, all of which were reviewed and excluded: a SCYL1 infantile liver failure case report, a GeneReviews revision of the SAMD9L chapter, a single case report of GDAP2-related SCA, and a case report plus systematic review of anti-GAD autoimmune cerebellar ataxia — none of them advances in polyQ or SCA therapy. Biohaven's troriluzole remains where it was at the 2025-11-04 CRL with no further development, and no new public press releases were found for Steminent, Vico, Arrowhead or PTC within the window.

body: 本筆一併回補 2026/08/21–08/23 三天（上次發布為 08/20，其間排程未執行，無資料缺口未回補）。（1）新增競品試驗 1 筆：Larimar Therapeutics 的 nomlabofusp 全球確認性三期 NCT07778836 於 2026/08/21 首次登錄上線，實際起始日 2026/08/05、狀態收案中。隨機雙盲安慰劑對照多中心，n=150，納入成人與兒童之基因確診（GAA 同型合子）Friedreich's ataxia、mFARS 總分 ≥20 且 <60；雙主要終點皆在第 72 週——mFARS 的 Upright Stability Score（subscale E）與 mFARS 總分之基線變化；主要完成日預估 2029/07；目前登錄 3 站、全在美國（Northwestern、Clinilabs、UT Southwestern）。此案結構上值得記一筆：該藥的加速核准滾動式 BLA 走 frataxin 濃度替代終點，本三期則是臨床療效的確認性試驗，兩條路並行；同步更新試驗雷達、競品全景（Larimar 該列）與競品動態三處。⚠️ 本試驗尚無任何療效數據，公司先前公開的 2027 年年中上市目標屬公司自述、非監管承諾。（2）新增 2 則科學文獻：① 日本大分大學 42 名遺傳性脊髓小腦退化症病人追蹤約 9 年（Acta Neurol Belg），ICARS 年惡化 2.6±5.9 分，初診時半數已有小腦外症狀（錐體路 31.0%、感覺 21.4%、自律神經 16.7%）——⚠️ 用的是 ICARS 而非 SARA，數字不可與 EUROSCA／CRC-SCA 的年進展率互換；② 巴西 Porto Alegre 174 名無垂直家族史共濟失調病人的 20 年回顧（Cerebellum），完成評估的 120 人中僅 45 人取得確定診斷，基因檢測產率依方法差異大（套組 71.4%／外顯子體 52.9%／全基因體 14%）——對以基因型為納入條件的試驗招募端有直接意涵。本次掃描的其餘結果：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢中，polyglutamine 與 episodic ataxia／CACNA1A 兩組窗內無新療法試驗；SBMA 組窗內命中多為前列腺癌與 SMA（依準則排除），無新 SBMA 療法；SCA 組窗內新出現的 NCT07752095（小腦 DBS）、NCT07743866（顳干擾電刺激）依準則排除神經調節，NCT02741440（NEI 的 SCA7 自然史）排除觀察性研究。Biohaven、Vico、Arrowhead、IntraBio、PTC 等既有競品在此三日窗內未見新公開新聞稿；VO659（NCT05822908）登錄雖於 08/19 更新，內容與 08/20 已收錄者相同，未重複記錄。

en.body: This entry backfills the three days 2026/08/21–08/23 (the last publication was 08/20 and the schedule did not run in between; no gap is left uncovered). (1) One competitor trial added: Larimar Therapeutics' global confirmatory Phase 3 of nomlabofusp, NCT07778836, was first posted to the registry on 2026/08/21 with an actual start date of 2026/08/05 and a status of recruiting. It is randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled and multicentre, n=150, enrolling adults and children with genetically confirmed (homozygous GAA) Friedreich's ataxia and a total mFARS score ≥20 and <60; both primary endpoints fall at Week 72 — change from baseline in the mFARS Upright Stability Score (subscale E) and in total mFARS; estimated primary completion is July 2029; 3 sites are registered, all in the United States (Northwestern, Clinilabs, UT Southwestern). The structure is what makes it worth recording: the drug's rolling BLA for accelerated approval rests on a frataxin-concentration surrogate, while this Phase 3 is the confirmatory trial of clinical benefit, the two running in parallel. The trial radar, the competitor landscape (Larimar's row) and the competitor-news section were all updated. ⚠️ No efficacy data from this trial exist yet, and the mid-2027 launch target the company has stated publicly is its own guidance rather than a regulatory commitment. (2) Two scientific papers added: (i) a Japanese cohort at Oita University following 42 patients with hereditary spinocerebellar degeneration for roughly 9 years (Acta Neurol Belg), with annual ICARS deterioration of 2.6±5.9 points and half already showing extracerebellar signs at baseline (pyramidal 31.0%, sensory 21.4%, autonomic 16.7%) — ⚠️ scored with ICARS rather than SARA, so the figures are not interchangeable with EUROSCA/CRC-SCA progression rates; (ii) a 20-year retrospective from Porto Alegre, Brazil, of 174 ataxia patients without a vertical family history (Cerebellum), in which only 45 of the 120 who completed evaluation reached a definitive diagnosis and molecular yield varied sharply by method (panel 71.4% / exome 52.9% / genome 14%) — with direct implications for recruitment into any trial requiring a genotype for entry. Remaining coverage of this scan: among the five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries, the polyglutamine and episodic ataxia/CACNA1A sets returned no new therapeutic trials in the window; the SBMA set returned mostly prostate cancer and SMA studies (excluded under the criteria) and no new SBMA therapy; and in the SCA set the newly appearing NCT07752095 (cerebellar DBS) and NCT07743866 (temporal interference stimulation) were excluded as neuromodulation, while NCT02741440 (the NEI SCA7 natural history study) was excluded as observational. No new public press releases were found for Biohaven, Vico, Arrowhead, IntraBio or PTC within this three-day window; the VO659 registration (NCT05822908) was updated on 08/19 but its content matches what was already recorded on 08/20, so it was not duplicated.

body: 當日第二次掃描的補收（當天稍早已發布一次，本筆只記其後出現的新事實）。（1）競品重要進度：IntraBio 的 CACNA1A 樞紐三期已開始收案——IB1001-304／NCT07221292 於 2026/08/20 更新登錄，狀態自「尚未收案」轉為收案中，實際起始日 2026/08/17，比先前登錄的估計起始日 2026/09 提前；10 個站點中 7 站已收案（美國 UT Health 休士頓，歐洲 Innsbruck、Cologne、Milan、羅馬 Bambino Gesù、Bern、Oxford），Johns Hopkins、麻省總醫院、雅典 3 站尚未啟動。公司 2026/08/19 新聞稿另稱預期超額收案、2026/10 完成收案。此案 12 週隨機雙盲安慰劑對照交叉、n≈60、4 歲以上、主要指標 SARA，登錄的合格標準明列 SCA6，與本社日本申請的 SCA6 適應症正面重疊，故同步更新試驗雷達、競品全景與競品動態三處。⚠️ 完成時程兩來源不一致、本站並列不擇一：登錄主要完成日 2028/08/01，新聞稿則稱收案結束後 6 個月完成（約 2027/04）；且尚無任何療效數據讀出，「超額收案」屬公司自述。（2）新增 1 則科學文獻：彰化基督教醫院團隊在 Frontiers in Pharmacology 發表把 Friedreich's 已核准藥 omaveloxolone（RTA-408，Nrf2 活化劑）測到 SCA3 模型的臨床前研究，細胞模型中 0.3–0.5 μM 改善存活與降低凋亡、果蠅模型部分改善存活與運動表現。⚠️ 純細胞與果蠅層級、無哺乳類與人體資料，亦無 SCA3 適應症的註冊試驗；記錄理由是鄰近圈層已核准口服小分子若向 polyQ 外擴屬早期訊號。本次補掃的其餘結果：CT.gov 五組適應症查詢中，Friedreich、polyglutamine 兩組窗內無更新；SBMA 組窗內僅英國 SMA 病人登錄庫（NCT04292574，適應症為 SMA、且為登錄庫非療法）予以排除；SCA 組窗內另有 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史研究（NCT02741440），依收錄準則排除觀察性自然史研究。

en.body: Backfill from a second scan the same day (an earlier run was published that morning; this entry records only facts that appeared afterwards). (1) A material competitor development: IntraBio's pivotal CACNA1A Phase III has begun enrolling — IB1001-304 / NCT07221292 was updated in the registry on 2026/08/20, moving from not-yet-recruiting to recruiting, with an actual start date of 2026/08/17, ahead of the previously registered estimate of 2026/09; 7 of 10 sites are now recruiting (UT Health Houston in the US, and Innsbruck, Cologne, Milan, Bambino Gesù in Rome, Bern and Oxford in Europe), while Johns Hopkins, Massachusetts General Hospital and Athens have not yet opened. A company press release dated 2026/08/19 additionally states it expects to over-enrol and complete recruitment in October 2026. The trial is a 12-week randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover study, n≈60, age 4 and over, with SARA as the primary endpoint, and the registered eligibility criteria explicitly list SCA6 — directly overlapping the SCA6 indication in our own Japan filing — so the trial radar, competitor landscape and competitor-news sections were all updated. ⚠️ The two sources disagree on the completion timeline and this site reports both rather than choosing: the registered primary completion date is 2028/08/01, while the press release describes completion six months after enrolment closes (around 2027/04); and no efficacy data have been read out, with 'over-enrolment' being a company statement. (2) One scientific paper added: a group at Changhua Christian Hospital published preclinical work in Frontiers in Pharmacology testing omaveloxolone (RTA-408, an Nrf2 activator already approved for Friedreich's ataxia) in SCA3 models, where 0.3–0.5 μM improved viability and reduced apoptosis in cells and partially improved survival and locomotor performance in Drosophila. ⚠️ The work is confined to cellular and fly models with no mammalian or human data, and no registered trial exists in this indication; it is recorded because an approved oral small molecule in the adjacent ring expanding toward polyQ disorders would be an early signal. Remaining coverage of this supplementary scan: among the five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries, the Friedreich and polyglutamine sets had no updates in the window; the SBMA set returned only the UK SMA Patient Registry (NCT04292574), excluded as an SMA registry rather than a therapy; and the SCA set returned the NEI SCA7 natural history study (NCT02741440), excluded as observational natural history under the inclusion criteria.

body: 新增 2 則科學文獻，兩篇都是日本的臨床流行病學／基因診斷資料，不是療法進展。① 橫濱市大＋北海道大學的 SCAR32 病例系列（Journal of Human Genetics）：從 411 名重複序列擴增檢測陰性的共濟失調病人中找出 4 名 PRDX3 雙股致病變異患者，發病 9–30 歲、以單純小腦症候群為主，MRI 全數可見小腦萎縮與齒狀核 T2 高訊號；p.Arg207* 在東亞頻率偏高、佔該未確診世代 0.97%。② 北海道大學的北海道顯性 SCA 亞型變遷（Journal of the Neurological Sciences，Letter）：以日本難病公費給付資料觀察到多系統受侵型占比持續下降、無法歸類的「未確定」病例持續增加——該篇無公開摘要，故本平台只記錄標題明示的方向、不引用任何未經查證的數字。兩篇的共同實務意涵在收案端而非療法端：日本是本社 Stemchymal® 持有孤兒再生醫療產品資格的市場，而「重複序列陰性者仍有約 1% 可歸因於單一隱性基因」與「未確定病例增加」都指向 polyQ 適應症療法在基因確診環節的篩檢負擔與篩落率。另更新 1 筆試驗登錄：Vico VO659（NCT05822908）登錄於 2026-08-19 更新、狀態查核日 2026-08，經逐站點核對，14 個站點仍全在歐洲與以色列（荷蘭 2 站已停收），仍無美國站點，收案目標 68 人、主要完成日 2028-04。當日掃描結果：ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）近 7 天內無平台未收錄之療法型新試驗；競品新聞與法規面近 7 天亦無新事實（Biohaven troriluzole 仍停在 2025-11-04 的 CRL，無新進展）。

en.body: Added 2 scientific papers, both Japanese clinical-epidemiology / genetic-diagnosis data rather than therapeutic progress. (1) A SCAR32 case series from Yokohama City University with Hokkaido University (Journal of Human Genetics): four patients with biallelic PRDX3 variants identified among 411 ataxia patients negative for repeat expansions, onset at 9–30 years with a predominantly pure cerebellar phenotype, and cerebellar atrophy plus dentate T2 hyperintensity on MRI in all four; p.Arg207* is relatively frequent in East Asians and accounted for 0.97% of that undiagnosed cohort. (2) Shifting subtype composition of autosomal dominant SCA in Hokkaido (Journal of the Neurological Sciences, Letter): using Japan's intractable-disease insurance data, the authors report a continuing decline in multisystemic subtypes and a continuing rise in unassignable 'unidentified' cases — the Letter has no public abstract, so this platform records only the direction its title asserts and cites no unverified figures. The shared practical implication is on the enrolment side, not the therapy side: Japan is a market where our own Stemchymal® holds orphan regenerative medicine product designation, and both '~1% of repeat-negative patients attributable to a single recessive gene' and 'rising unidentified cases' point to the screening burden and screen-failure rate at the genetic-confirmation step for polyQ-indicated therapies. One trial record also updated: Vico's VO659 (NCT05822908) was refreshed in the registry on 2026-08-19 with a status-verified date of 2026-08; site-by-site review confirms all 14 sites remain in Europe and Israel (the 2 Dutch sites are active-not-recruiting) with still no US sites, target enrolment 68 and primary completion April 2028. Scan coverage today: the five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA / Friedreich / SBMA / polyglutamine / episodic ataxia-CACNA1A) returned no therapeutic trials from the last 7 days not already on the platform; no new verifiable competitor news or regulatory events either (Biohaven's troriluzole remains at the 2025-11-04 CRL with no further development).

body: 新增 3 則科學文獻，均為機轉與臨床前層次、無新競品或新試驗。其中兩篇指向同一個實務問題：斑馬魚 ataxin-1 家族基因剔除模型（Human Molecular Genetics，貝勒醫學院）顯示完全缺失 atxn1a／atxn1b／atxn1l 會造成存活率下降、運動缺損與神經發育／免疫相關轉錄改變；同期新收錄的明尼蘇達大學綜述（Neural Regeneration Research）則整理 ATXN1「功能增益 vs 功能缺失」的雙面性，指出缺乏 ATXN1 的小鼠認知嚴重受損。兩篇合起來替 SCA1 核酸療法的治療窗問題（降低 ATXN1 要壓多深、壓在哪些組織）補上證據，屬本社細胞治療路線之外的競品風險背景。第三篇為 Human Gene Therapy 的 Friedreich's 共濟失調基因療法臨床前研究（里昂 Puccio 團隊），以帶內源調控元件的 mini-frataxin 構築（miniFXN7）＋AAV-PHP.eB 全身給藥，在 Pvalb-cKO 小鼠達成運動協調與本體感覺改善——點出 FA 基因療法賽道共通的「FXN 表現量必須控制在生理區間」風險，與已在臨床的 Lexeo LX2006、Solid SGT-212 並非同一構築。當日掃描結果：ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）近 7 天內無平台未收錄之療法型新試驗（新出現者僅小腦深部腦刺激 NCT07752095 與經顱時間干涉刺激 NCT07743866，依收錄準則排除神經調節研究）；競品新聞與法規面近 7 天無新事實。

en.body: Added 3 scientific papers, all at the mechanistic or preclinical level; no new competitors and no new trials. Two of them converge on the same practical question: zebrafish knockouts of the ataxin-1 family genes (Human Molecular Genetics, Baylor College of Medicine) show that complete loss of atxn1a/atxn1b/atxn1l reduces survival and causes locomotor deficits plus neurodevelopmental and immune-related transcriptional changes, while a University of Minnesota review indexed the same week (Neural Regeneration Research) sets out the gain-of-function versus loss-of-function duality of ATXN1 and notes that mice lacking ATXN1 are severely cognitively impaired. Together they supply evidence on the therapeutic-window question for SCA1 nucleic-acid therapies — how deeply, and in which tissues, ATXN1 can be lowered — which is background on competitor risk rather than anything bearing on our own cell-therapy route. The third is a Friedreich ataxia gene-therapy preclinical study in Human Gene Therapy (Puccio group, Lyon) using a mini-frataxin construct with an endogenous regulatory element (miniFXN7) delivered systemically by AAV-PHP.eB, achieving improved motor coordination and proprioception in Pvalb-cKO mice — highlighting the dose-control risk shared across the FA gene-therapy lane, though the construct is not the same as the clinical-stage Lexeo LX2006 or Solid SGT-212. Scan coverage today: the five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA / Friedreich / SBMA / polyglutamine / episodic ataxia-CACNA1A) returned no therapeutic trials from the last 7 days that the platform had not already recorded — the only new entries were cerebellar deep brain stimulation (NCT07752095) and transcranial temporal interference stimulation (NCT07743866), both excluded as neuromodulation under the inclusion criteria. No new verifiable competitor news or regulatory events in the last 7 days.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻、1 筆競品試驗、1 筆結果讀出，並新增清單外競品 Quince Therapeutics 一家（競品全景＋公司情報卡）。主動發現：以 ATXN1/2/3、Machado-Joseph、polyglutamine ataxia、cerebellar ataxia 等替代索引詞擴大 PubMed 掃描時，掃出 Quince Therapeutics 的 eDSP（EryDex，地塞米松磷酸鈉包覆於自體紅血球）三期 NEAT 試驗全文，2026/08/14 發表於 The Lancet Child & Adolescent Health——此公司與其三期資產此前完全未被本平台收錄，屬清單外漏收。試驗設計為隨機雙盲安慰劑對照，收案年滿 6 歲、體重 ≥15 kg 之基因確診共濟失調微血管擴張症（A-T）病人，n=105（eDSP 51／安慰劑 54），每 21–30 天靜脈給藥一次共六劑，2024/06 至 2025/12 執行於 9 國 20 站點。主要終點為 6–9 歲族群第 6 個月 RmICARS 自基線變化，未達統計顯著：最小平方均數差 −1.30（95% CI −2.77 至 0.18；p=0.085）；安全性良好，兩組不良事件率約 92–93%、無治療相關嚴重不良事件。公司已於 2026/01/29 發布 topline，本次收錄的是同儕審查全文。⚠️ 須明確標示：A-T 與本社 SCA3／SCA6 為不同疾病（A-T 係 ATM 基因缺陷所致之隱性遺傳性共濟失調，合併免疫缺失與癌症易感性，非 polyQ 疾病），Quince 與本社無適應症或市場重疊、不構成直接競爭威脅，威脅等級列為「低(A-T)」。收錄理由有二：其一，A-T 屬本平台既已追蹤的鄰近共濟失調圈層（波士頓兒童醫院 Timothy Yu 的 atipeksen 客製化 ASO 試驗 NCT07215416 已在列），此為補齊該圈層的漏收；其二為終點方法學——RmICARS 與本社主要終點 SARA 同屬臨床醫師評分量表家族，而 p=0.085、信賴區間上緣僅略越零界的結果型態，是追蹤期與樣本數不足以壓過量表變異的典型樣貌，構成近期第四筆指向「共濟失調臨床量表在六至十二個月窗口內偵測力不足」的證據。惟已於各筆資料中註明不可直接外推：NEAT 僅六個月六劑，療程遠短於本社試驗，且 A-T 為兒童期快速進展疾病，其進展速率與量表行為均與成人晚發之 SCA3／SCA6 不同。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢近 7 天內無新療法型試驗：SCA 圈層窗內更新僅 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史（NCT02741440，觀察性，依 §1b 不收）；Friedreich's 組窗內更新之 Solid Biosciences NCT07180355 與 PTC NCT07681713 均為既有已收錄試驗之例行更新，非新事實；polyQ 組回傳者皆為本社既有試驗與 2011 年舊登錄；CACNA1A 組近 7 天無更新；SBMA 組僅 NINDS 生物標記觀察研究（NCT04944940）與 NICHD 雄性素受體研究（NCT04708431）更新，其餘為前列腺癌試驗，逐筆確認適應症後排除。PubMed 基本查詢（spinocerebellar ataxia，近 4 日）回傳之 4 筆均已在庫；擴大索引詞後新增的 6 筆中，除上述 NEAT 外，其餘 5 筆（小腦梗塞個案、GSS 病、UBTF 相關兒童神經退化、Chiari I 畸形綜述、狼瘡眼陣攣個案）與 SCA 及追蹤競品均無關，不予收錄。競品新聞掃描（仲恩 Stemchymal／REPROCELL 日本查驗登記、Biohaven troriluzole／VYGLXIA、Vico VO659、Arrowhead ARO-ATXN2、PTC vatiquinone、Solaxa SLX-100／Alvogen 授權）未見近 7 天內的新事實，檢索命中者均為既有已記錄事件之轉載。

en.body: Added 1 paper, 1 competitor trial and 1 results readout, along with a new off-list competitor, Quince Therapeutics (competitor landscape plus company card). Proactive discovery: widening the PubMed sweep to alternative indexing terms — ATXN1/2/3, Machado-Joseph, polyglutamine ataxia, cerebellar ataxia — surfaced the full paper for the Phase 3 NEAT trial of Quince Therapeutics' eDSP (EryDex, dexamethasone sodium phosphate encapsulated in autologous erythrocytes), published in The Lancet Child & Adolescent Health on 2026/08/14. Neither the company nor its Phase 3 asset had ever been captured on this platform — an off-list omission. The trial was randomised, double-blind and placebo-controlled, enrolling genetically confirmed ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T) patients aged 6 or older weighing at least 15 kg, n=105 (51 eDSP, 54 placebo), dosed intravenously every 21–30 days for six doses, running from June 2024 to December 2025 across 20 sites in nine countries. The primary endpoint — change from baseline in RmICARS at month 6 among participants aged 6–9 — was not met: least-squares mean difference −1.30 (95% CI −2.77 to 0.18; p=0.085). Safety was favourable, with adverse events in roughly 92–93% of both arms and no serious treatment-related events. The company had released topline results on 2026/01/29; what is recorded here is the peer-reviewed full paper. ⚠️ To state it plainly: A-T is a different disease from our own SCA3/SCA6 — a recessive ataxia caused by ATM deficiency, accompanied by immunodeficiency and cancer predisposition, and not a polyQ disease. Quince overlaps with us in neither indication nor market and poses no direct competitive threat; its threat level is recorded as Low (A-T). It is included for two reasons. First, A-T sits in the adjacent ataxia ring the platform already tracks (Timothy Yu's bespoke ASO trial at Boston Children's Hospital, NCT07215416, is already listed), so this fills a gap in that ring. Second, endpoint methodology: RmICARS belongs to the same family of clinician-rated scales as SARA, our own primary endpoint, and a result of p=0.085 with the upper confidence bound only just crossing zero is the classic signature of follow-up and sample size insufficient to overcome scale variance — the fourth recent data point suggesting that clinical ataxia scales lack power within a six- to twelve-month window. Each record notes that this does not transfer directly: NEAT ran for only six months and six doses, far shorter than our own trials, and A-T is a rapidly progressing childhood disease whose progression rate and scale behaviour differ from adult late-onset SCA3/SCA6. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned no new therapeutic trials within the past 7 days: in the SCA ring the only update in the window was the NEI natural history study in SCA7 (NCT02741440), observational and ineligible under §1b; in the Friedreich's group, Solid Biosciences' NCT07180355 and PTC's NCT07681713 were routine updates to trials already on record, not new facts; the polyglutamine query returned only our own existing trials and a registration from 2011; the CACNA1A query showed no updates in the window; and the SBMA query returned only the NINDS biomarker study (NCT04944940) and the NICHD androgen receptor study (NCT04708431) alongside prostate cancer trials, excluded after checking each indication. All four hits from the baseline PubMed query (spinocerebellar ataxia, past 4 days) were already held; of the six additional records surfaced by the widened index terms, the other five — a cerebellar infarct case report, Gerstmann-Sträussler-Scheinker disease, UBTF-related childhood neurodegeneration, a Chiari I malformation review and a lupus opsoclonus case — bear no relation to SCA or any tracked competitor and were not recorded. The competitor news sweep (Steminent/REPROCELL's Japanese filing, Biohaven troriluzole/VYGLXIA, Vico VO659, Arrowhead ARO-ATXN2, PTC vatiquinone, Solaxa SLX-100 and the Alvogen licence) found no new facts within the past 7 days — every hit restated an event already on record.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻、2 筆競品試驗（回補）、1 筆自然史世代。文獻：圖賓根 Synofzik／Traschütz 團隊發表於 EBioMedicine 的 SCA27B 首份多中心縱貫進展數據（219 名病人、661 次評估，德法奧加澳多國）。核心數字：整體年進展僅 0.54 SARA 分/年（95% CI 0.37–0.71），比 EUROSCA 最慢的 SCA6（0.80）還慢；嚴重度幾乎全由步態、站姿、下肢貢獻；較短等位基因亦帶 (GAA)>180 者進展快 +1.6 分/年（95% CI 0.9–2.2）；與對照組的鑑別力隨年齡下降。此為觀察性世代研究、未檢驗任何療法。 收錄理由：SCA27B 是目前唯一有廠商宣布要做三期的 SCA 亞型（Solaxa SLX-100），而此數據對該試驗是雙面刃——如此慢的進展速率使「壓平斜率」在合理年限內極難證明，除非以 (GAA)>180 做族群富集，本篇正好提供富集依據。對本社的意義落在方法學：這是近兩週第三篇指向「SARA 在慢進展亞型上量不動」的文獻，而本社日本申請的 SCA6 正屬慢進展組。同步在疾病自然史建立該世代一筆。試驗回補：本週已知資產點名查核（§1b-2）掃出 Design Therapeutics 的 NCT06874010（DT-216P2 RESTORE-FA，Ph1/2 開放標籤、n=20、澳洲三站，收案中）與 NCT06772870（健康受試者單次遞增劑量、雙盲對照、n=36）長期未被收錄——兩筆最後更新分別停在 2025-05-18 與 2025-02-21，日掃的 LastUpdatePostDate:desc 排序永遠撈不到，正是 §1b-2 設計要攔截的漏收型態；Design 的公司情報卡先前試驗欄為空，本次一併補齊 match 別名。兩筆均已標註登錄陳舊（公司 2026/05 已公布四週靜脈給藥數據，登錄落後於實際進度）。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢近 7 天內無新療法型試驗：SCA 圈層窗內更新僅 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史（NCT02741440，觀察性，依 §1b 不收）；Friedreich's 組窗內更新之 PTC NCT07681713 已於 08/14 收錄；polyQ、CACNA1A 兩組近 7 天無更新；SBMA 組僅 NINDS／NICHD 觀察研究與前列腺癌試驗，逐筆確認適應症後排除。點名查核另查 SLX-100、NLX-112、DT-216、Leriglitazone、VO659、ARO-ATXN2、Stemchymal：Solaxa SLX-100 迄今仍未在 CT.gov 登錄任何試驗（宣布三期計畫已逾一年），Neurolixis NLX-112 亦無 SCA 適應症試驗登錄，其餘無新 NCT。競品新聞掃描未見近 7 天內的新事實，檢索命中者均為既有已記錄事件之轉載。

en.body: Added 1 paper, 2 competitor trials (backfilled) and 1 natural-history cohort. The paper, from Synofzik and Traschütz in Tübingen and published in EBioMedicine, is the first multicentre longitudinal progression dataset for SCA27B (219 patients, 661 assessments, across Germany, France, Austria, Canada and Australia). The headline figures: overall progression of just 0.54 SARA points/year (95% CI 0.37–0.71), slower than SCA6 (0.80), the slowest subtype in EUROSCA; severity attributable almost entirely to gait, stance and lower-limb impairment; (GAA)>180 on the shorter allele associated with +1.6 points/year (95% CI 0.9–2.2); and discrimination from controls declining with age. This is an observational cohort study; no therapy is tested. Why it is recorded: SCA27B is the only SCA subtype for which a sponsor has announced a Phase 3 (Solaxa's SLX-100), and the dataset cuts both ways for that trial — at this rate of decline, demonstrating a flattened slope within a feasible duration is very hard unless the population is enriched using a modifier such as (GAA)>180, for which this paper supplies the rationale. The bearing on our own programme is methodological: this is the third paper in a fortnight pointing at the limits of SARA in slowly-progressing subtypes, and SCA6 — one of the two indications in our Japanese application — sits in that group. A corresponding cohort entry was added under Natural History. On the trials: this week's roll-call check of known assets (§1b-2) found that Design Therapeutics' NCT06874010 (DT-216P2, RESTORE-FA; Ph1/2, open-label, n=20, three Australian sites, recruiting) and NCT06772870 (single ascending dose in healthy participants, double-masked, placebo-controlled, n=36) had long been missing. Their registry entries were last updated on 2025-05-18 and 2025-02-21 respectively, so the daily LastUpdatePostDate:desc sort could never surface them — precisely the failure mode §1b-2 exists to catch. Design's company card previously showed an empty trials column; its match aliases were extended at the same time. Both entries are flagged as stale registrations: the company released four-week IV data in 2026/05, so the registry lags actual progress. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned no new therapeutic trials in the past 7 days: within the SCA ring the only update in the window was the NEI SCA7 natural history study (NCT02741440), observational and ineligible under §1b; the Friedreich's query surfaced PTC's NCT07681713, recorded on 14 August; the polyglutamine and CACNA1A queries showed no updates; and the SBMA query returned only NINDS and NICHD observational studies alongside prostate cancer trials, excluded after checking each indication. The roll-call also queried SLX-100, NLX-112, DT-216, leriglitazone, VO659, ARO-ATXN2 and Stemchymal: Solaxa has still registered no trial of SLX-100 on ClinicalTrials.gov, more than a year after announcing its Phase 3 plan; Neurolixis has no registered trial of NLX-112 in an SCA indication; and no other new NCTs appeared. The competitor news sweep found no new facts within the past 7 days — every hit restated an event already on record.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻。中國中南大學湘雅醫院（長沙）團隊發表於 Parkinsonism & Related Disorders：129 名 SCA3 受試者對 78 名對照的縱貫性影像研究，測量 DTI-ALPS 指數（沿血管周隙的擴散張量影像分析，一種以 MRI 間接評估腦內組織液／血管周隙引流環境的指標）。結果為指數下降主要出現在症狀期病人，並與病情較重、腦幹萎縮、後續進展較快相關。此為相關性研究、非介入試驗：未檢驗任何療法，亦無證據說明引流受損是病因或病程的結果。收錄理由：SCA3 為本社日本查驗登記申請的兩個適應症之一，且本篇補上了近月文獻反覆指向之主題的另一半——試驗終點的可測量性。08/12 的 SCA6 認知情緒研究與 08/09 的 SCA6 非運動症狀研究講的是 SARA 量不到的臨床面向；本篇提供的是可在單一時點取得、且與後續進展速度相關的客觀影像指標，原理上正是細胞治療這類進展緩慢、需長期追蹤的療法最缺的工具。惟距離能當試驗終點仍遠：單一中心中國世代、未經他組重現，DTI-ALPS 方法學於神經影像領域仍具爭議（受掃描參數與頭位影響），且目前無任何 SCA 試驗以其為次要指標。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢近 7 天內無新療法型試驗：SCA 圈層窗內更新為 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史（NCT02741440）與多亞型自然史（NCT01060371），屬觀察性、依 §1b 不予收錄；Baltuch 團隊小腦 DBS（NCT07752095）與福建醫大附一經顱時間干涉刺激（NCT07743866）屬神經調節，同不予收錄；Friedreich's 組窗內更新之 PTC NCT07681713（PROVE-FA）已於 08/14 收錄；polyQ 與 CACNA1A 兩組近 7 天無更新；SBMA 組窗內僅 NINDS 生物標記觀察研究（NCT04944940）與 NICHD 雄性素受體研究（NCT04708431）更新，其餘為前列腺癌試驗，逐筆確認適應症後排除。競品新聞掃描（仲恩 Stemchymal／REPROCELL 日本查驗登記、Biohaven troriluzole／VYGLXIA、Vico VO659、Arrowhead／Sarepta ARO-ATXN2）未見近 7 天內的新事實，檢索命中者均為既有已記錄事件之轉載。姊妹站 MSA-IQ 當日新增 1 篇皮膚 α-突觸核蛋白種子活性文獻。

en.body: One paper added. From Xiangya Hospital, Central South University (Changsha, China), in Parkinsonism & Related Disorders: a longitudinal imaging study of 129 SCA3 participants against 78 controls measuring the DTI-ALPS index (diffusion tensor image analysis along the perivascular space, an MRI-derived proxy for the neurofluid and perivascular drainage environment). The index was reduced predominantly in symptomatic patients and was associated with greater severity, brainstem atrophy and faster subsequent progression. This is correlational rather than interventional work: no therapy is tested, and nothing establishes whether impaired drainage is a cause or a consequence of the disease course. Why it is recorded: SCA3 is one of the two indications in our own Japanese marketing application, and the paper supplies the other half of a theme the recent literature keeps returning to — what a trial can actually measure. The SCA6 cognitive study of 12 August and the SCA6 non-motor study of 09 August concerned clinical domains SARA cannot see; this one offers an objective imaging measure, obtainable at a single timepoint, that tracks with the rate of subsequent progression — in principle the tool most lacking for a slowly-acting therapy requiring long follow-up, cell therapy included. It remains far from serving as a trial endpoint: a single-centre Chinese cohort without independent replication, DTI-ALPS methodology still contested within neuroimaging (sensitive to acquisition parameters and head positioning), and no SCA trial currently using it even as a secondary measure. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned no new therapeutic trials in the past 7 days: within the SCA ring the updates in the window were the NEI SCA7 natural history study (NCT02741440) and the multi-subtype natural history study (NCT01060371), both observational and ineligible under §1b, alongside the Baltuch cerebellar DBS study (NCT07752095) and the transcranial temporal interference stimulation study from Fujian Medical University (NCT07743866), both neuromodulation and likewise excluded; the Friedreich's query surfaced PTC's NCT07681713 (PROVE-FA), recorded on 14 August; the polyglutamine and CACNA1A queries showed no updates in the window; and the SBMA query returned only an NINDS observational biomarker study (NCT04944940) and an NICHD androgen receptor study (NCT04708431) alongside the usual prostate cancer trials, excluded after checking the indication on each. The competitor news sweep (Steminent Stemchymal and the REPROCELL Japanese marketing application, Biohaven troriluzole/VYGLXIA, Vico VO659, Arrowhead/Sarepta ARO-ATXN2) found no new facts within the past 7 days — every hit was a restatement of an event already on record. Sister site MSA-IQ gained one paper today, on α-synuclein seeding activity in skin.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻與 1 筆主動掃描補收的競品試驗。（1）文獻：Trends in Neurosciences（紐約州立大學奧本尼分校 RNA 研究所）綜述指出，相似的替代性剪接（alternative splicing）改變普遍存在於 CAG 重複序列擴增疾病，橫跨亨丁頓舞蹈症與多個 SCA 亞型，並盤點受影響的基因與路徑。本篇為綜述、不含新數據，亦未提出任何進入臨床階段的剪接調控藥物用於 SCA。值得記錄的是它是十天內第二篇主張「polyQ 各亞型在下游收斂到同一個細胞層次故障」的綜述——前一篇為 08/04 收錄的自噬作用綜述（PubMed 42587819），但兩篇指的節點並不相同：一個在 RNA 加工、一個在蛋白清除。這個分歧本身就是重點：目前並無共識說哪一個才是真正的共通節點，兩者都停留在「以既有文獻重新詮釋」的階段。對本社的意義僅止於學理背景——現行 SCA 臨床競品幾乎都是基因專一設計（Vico VO659 打 ATXN3／ATXN1、Arrowhead／Sarepta ARO-ATXN2 打 ATXN2），代價是一個亞型一支藥；跨亞型共通機轉的文獻累積，是非基因專一療法（含細胞治療）主張可涵蓋多亞型的學理依據，本社日本申請即為 SCA3／SCA6 合併。機轉層次的匯流論述不等於療效證據。（2）試驗：主動掃描補收 NCT06862596（此前未在本平台登錄）——名古屋大學勝野雅央主持的 Med-SBMA 試驗，美西律（mexiletine）用於甘迺迪症／SBMA（polyQ 鄰近圈層）之多中心隨機雙盲安慰劑對照 Ph2/3，300 mg 每日三次口服 12 週、n=68、日本五站點，主要指標為第 4 週 ALSFRS-R 變化，主要完成日估 2027/12。屬症狀改善型老藥再定位、不改變病程；登錄自 2025-04-16 起未再更新，依鐵則於 status 標明，不把陳舊登錄當現況。此筆補收再次印證 §1b-2 的必要性——該試驗最後更新已逾一年，永遠排不進以最後更新日排序的日掃前 40 名。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢近 7 天內無其他新療法型試驗：SCA 圈層窗內更新為 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史（NCT02741440）與 NIH 資助之多亞型自然史（NCT01060371），屬觀察性、依 §1b 不予收錄；Friedreich's 組更新之 PTC NCT07681713（PROVE-FA）已於昨日收錄；polyQ 與 CACNA1A 兩組近 7 天無更新；SBMA 組僅 NINDS 生物標記觀察研究更新，其餘為前列腺癌試驗，逐筆確認後排除。競品新聞掃描（仲恩 Stemchymal、Biohaven troriluzole／VYGLXIA、Vico VO659、Arrowhead／Sarepta ARO-ATXN2）未見近 7 天內的新事實。姊妹站 MSA-IQ 當日新增 2 篇 α-突觸核蛋白株型文獻。

en.body: One paper added, plus one competitor trial recovered by the proactive sweep. (1) Paper: a review in Trends in Neurosciences from the RNA Institute at the University at Albany, SUNY, reports that similar alternative splicing changes are prevalent across the CAG repeat expansion diseases, spanning Huntington's disease and multiple SCA subtypes, and catalogues the genes and pathways affected. It is a review with no new data, and proposes no clinical-stage splicing-directed therapy for SCA. What makes it worth recording is that it is the second review in ten days to argue that the polyQ subtypes converge downstream on a single cellular failure — the first, recorded on 04 August (PubMed 42587819), located that convergence in autophagy. The two nominate different nodes, one in RNA processing and one in protein clearance. That disagreement is the point: there is no consensus on which, if either, is the genuine common node, and both remain reinterpretations of existing literature. The bearing on our own programme is background rationale only — the clinical competition in SCA is almost entirely gene-specific by design (Vico's VO659 against ATXN3/ATXN1, Arrowhead/Sarepta's ARO-ATXN2 against ATXN2), at the cost of one asset per subtype, so an accumulating literature on shared mechanism is the basis on which a non-gene-specific therapy, cell therapy included, claims to span subtypes, as our own Japanese application does for SCA3 and SCA6 together. A convergence argument at the level of mechanism is not evidence of efficacy. (2) Trial: the proactive sweep recovered NCT06862596, not previously on this platform — the Med-SBMA study run by Masahisa Katsuno at Nagoya University, a multicentre randomised double-blind placebo-controlled Ph2/3 of mexiletine in Kennedy's disease / SBMA, the adjacent polyQ ring: 300 mg orally three times daily for 12 weeks, n=68 across five Japanese sites, primary endpoint change in ALSFRS-R at week 4, primary completion estimated December 2027. It is a symptomatic repurposing that does not target disease course, and the registry has not been updated since 2025-04-16, stated in the status field per the standing rule so that a stale registration is not read as current fact. The recovery is a further demonstration of why §1b-2 exists: with its last update more than a year old, this trial can never rank into the top 40 of a daily scan sorted by last-update date. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned no other new therapeutic trials in the past 7 days: within the SCA ring the updates in the window were the NEI SCA7 natural history study (NCT02741440) and the NIH-funded multi-subtype natural history study (NCT01060371), both observational and therefore ineligible under §1b; the Friedreich's query surfaced PTC's NCT07681713 (PROVE-FA), already recorded yesterday; the polyglutamine and CACNA1A queries showed no updates in the window; and the SBMA query returned only an NINDS observational biomarker study alongside the usual prostate cancer trials, excluded after checking each record. The competitor news sweep (Steminent Stemchymal, Biohaven troriluzole/VYGLXIA, Vico VO659, Arrowhead/Sarepta ARO-ATXN2) found no new facts within the past 7 days. Sister site MSA-IQ gained two papers on α-synuclein strains today.

新增 1 則科學文獻與 6 筆補回的既有試驗。Cells（義大利國家研究委員會 CNR 轉譯藥理學研究所＋羅馬第二大學）綜述主張自噬功能受損是重複序列擴增型小腦共濟失調的匯流點機轉：把 polyQ 型的「蛋白質毒性」（SCA1／2／3／6／7）與非編碼區擴增型的「RNA 毒性」（SCA31／36 等）兩條原本分開討論的路線，收束到下游共同的細胞清除失能。本篇為綜述、不含新數據，「匯流」是文獻整合詮釋而非新證據，文中亦未提出任何臨床階段的自噬調節劑。記錄理由是它點出目前 SCA 臨床競品的結構性特徵——Vico VO659（ATXN3／ATXN1）與 Arrowhead／Sarepta ARO-ATXN2（ATXN2）皆為基因專一設計，代價是一個亞型一支藥；若下游確有跨亞型共通節點，那正是非基因專一療法（含細胞治療）在學理上可涵蓋多個 polyQ 亞型的理由，本社日本申請即為 SCA3／SCA6 合併。惟此僅止於機轉層次，不能當療效證據。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢近 7 天內無新療法型試驗：SCA 圈層當日更新為 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史（NCT02741440）、Baltuch 團隊的小腦 DBS（NCT07752095）與福建醫大附一的經顱時間干涉刺激（NCT07743866），後兩者屬神經調節、依 §1b 不予收錄；Friedreich's、polyQ、CACNA1A 三組近 7 天無新療法更新；SBMA 組僅 NINDS 生物標記觀察研究更新，其餘為前列腺癌試驗，逐筆確認後排除。競品新聞掃描（Biohaven／VYGLXIA、仲恩 Stemchymal、Vico VO659、Arrowhead／Sarepta ARO-ATXN2）未見近 7 天內的新事實。

另補做每週「已知資產點名查核」（§1b-2，上次為 08/06），以藥名而非疾病條件查詢，補回 6 筆長期漏收的試驗——這正是該節設計要抓的漏洞：這些試驗登錄多年未更新，永遠排不進以最後更新日排序的日掃前 40 名。(1) NCT02960893 Biohaven troriluzole Ph2/3，troriluzole 的首個 SCA 樞紐試驗、主要終點未達；(2) NCT06034886 Biohaven troriluzole 擴大取得方案（EAP，開放中）——非試驗，是 SCA 病人核准前的取藥管道；(3) NCT03408080 UCLA 主導之 BHV-4157 開放標籤試驗性研究（族群含 SCA 與 MSA-C）；(4) NCT05160558 Biogen／Ionis BIIB132（ION260）ATXN3 ASO Ph1，2023 已終止；(5) NCT05490563 Seelos SLS-005（海藻糖）STRIDES Ph2/3 於 SCA3，已終止；(6) NCT04120493 uniQure AMT-130 Ph1/2（亨丁頓舞蹈症，polyQ 鄰近圈層；歐洲平行試驗為 NCT05243017）。六筆均依鐵則於 status 標明登錄最後更新日，不把陳舊登錄當現況。另有兩筆經評估後不予收錄：馬來西亞國立大學的口服海藻糖 SCA3 研究（NCT04426149 已完成、NCT04399265 狀態自 2022 起為「未知」），屬小型學術研究且已由 Seelos 的產業級 STRIDES 試驗取代，收錄僅增雜訊。姊妹站 MSA-IQ 當日新增 2 篇文獻與 1 則領域動態（Alterity ATH434 美國物質組成專利獲准）。

en.body:
One paper added, plus six previously missing trials recovered. A review in Cells (Institute of Translational Pharmacology, National Research Council (CNR), with the University of Rome Tor Vergata) argues that impaired autophagy is a convergent pathogenic mechanism across the repeat expansion cerebellar ataxias, drawing together two routes usually discussed separately — protein-mediated toxicity in the polyQ ataxias (SCA1/2/3/6/7) and RNA-mediated toxicity in the non-coding expansions (SCA31, SCA36) — into a shared downstream failure of cellular clearance. It is a review with no new data; the convergence is a synthesis of existing literature rather than new evidence, and no clinical-stage autophagy modulator is proposed. It is recorded because it names a structural feature of the current SCA competition: Vico's VO659 (ATXN3/ATXN1) and Arrowhead/Sarepta's ARO-ATXN2 (ATXN2) are both gene-specific by design, at the cost of one asset per subtype. If a shared downstream node genuinely exists, that is the mechanistic rationale for a non-gene-specific therapy — cell therapy included — spanning several polyQ subtypes, as our own Japanese application does for SCA3 and SCA6 together. This is an argument at the level of mechanism and is not evidence of efficacy. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned no new therapeutic trials in the past 7 days: within the SCA ring the updates were the NEI SCA7 natural history study (NCT02741440), a cerebellar DBS study (NCT07752095) and a transcranial temporal interference stimulation study (NCT07743866), the latter two being neuromodulation and therefore ineligible under §1b; the Friedreich's, polyglutamine and CACNA1A queries showed no new therapeutic updates in the window; and the SBMA query returned only an NINDS observational biomarker study alongside the usual prostate cancer trials, excluded after checking each record. The competitor news sweep (Biohaven/VYGLXIA, Steminent Stemchymal, Vico VO659, Arrowhead/Sarepta ARO-ATXN2) found no new facts within the past 7 days.

The weekly roll-call of known assets (§1b-2, last run 06 August) was also carried out, querying by drug name rather than disease condition, and recovered six long-missing trials — exactly the gap that section exists to catch, since these registrations have gone years without an update and can never rank into the top 40 of a daily scan sorted by last-update date. (1) NCT02960893, Biohaven's troriluzole Ph2/3, the first pivotal SCA trial of the drug, which missed its primary endpoint; (2) NCT06034886, Biohaven's troriluzole expanded access programme (Available) — not a trial but a route for SCA patients to obtain the drug before approval; (3) NCT03408080, an investigator-initiated open-label pilot of BHV-4157 at UCLA, in a population spanning SCA and MSA-C; (4) NCT05160558, Biogen/Ionis's BIIB132 (ION260) ATXN3 ASO Ph1, terminated in 2023; (5) NCT05490563, Seelos's SLS-005 (trehalose) STRIDES Ph2/3 in SCA3, terminated; and (6) NCT04120493, uniQure's AMT-130 Ph1/2 in Huntington's disease, the adjacent polyQ ring, with a parallel European trial as NCT05243017. Per the standing rule, each entry states in its status field when the registry was last updated, so that stale registrations are not read as current fact. Two further records were considered and excluded: the oral trehalose studies in SCA3 from the National University of Malaysia (NCT04426149, completed; NCT04399265, status 'unknown' since 2022) are small academic studies superseded by Seelos's industry-scale STRIDES trial, and would add noise rather than signal. Sister site MSA-IQ gained two papers and one field update today (a US composition-of-matter patent granted for Alterity's ATH434).

en.body: One paper added. The Cerebellum (Federal University of São Paulo (UNIFESP) with the University of Campinas) compared standardised neuropsychological assessment in 9 genetically confirmed SCA6 patients against 8 matched controls, finding worse performance on visuoconstructive and visuomotor integration tasks, poorer verbal episodic memory and elevated anxiety. The authors describe the study as exploratory and explicitly list its limitations as a very small sample with no correction for multiple comparisons — uncorrected differences at n=9 versus 8 need replication in a larger sample and should not be cited as settled. What makes it worth recording is how it complements the SCA6 non-motor study from the same Brazilian group added yesterday (PubMed 42571931): that paper looked at sensory symptoms, fatigue and autonomic function, this one at cognition and affect, and both point the same way — part of the disease burden in SCA6 sits where SARA cannot see it, and SCA6 is one of the two indications in our Japanese application. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned no new therapeutic trials within the past 7 days: the SCA-ring updates were the NEI SCA7 natural history study (NCT02741440) and an NIH-funded multi-subtype natural history study (NCT01060371), both observational and ineligible under §1b; the Friedreich's, polyglutamine and CACNA1A queries showed no updates in the window; and the SBMA query was again dominated by prostate cancer trials, excluded after checking each record. The competitor news sweep (Biohaven/VYGLXIA, Steminent Stemchymal, Vico VO659, Arrowhead ARO-ATXN2) found no new facts within the past 7 days. Sister site MSA-IQ had no new entries from either ClinicalTrials.gov or PubMed: the two new papers (the structure of the α-synuclein/DJ-1 complex, and voice disorders as a marker of cognitive decline) were checked individually and mention MSA only in passing rather than studying it, so both were excluded under the standing rule.

body: 新增 2 則科學文獻，兩則都指向同一件事：SARA 之外，我們還量到了什麼。The Cerebellum 刊出日本七家醫院、74 名小腦退化病人的多中心驗證研究，以標準化觸控螢幕的稜鏡適應測驗取得「適應性指數」，跨院一致性以線性混合效果模型檢驗，並比較 SCA6 與 SCA31 兩基因型的變異數；該指數與 SARA 呈負相關（r = −0.364、p < 0.01）。這是少見的、以客觀操作表現而非評分者判斷為基礎的終點候選——但相關性僅中等，本研究也未證明它對疾病進展更敏感（那需要縱貫資料）。作者群即日本共濟失調臨床研究網絡核心成員。Movement Disorders Clinical Practice（巴西聖保羅聯邦大學）評估 18 名基因確診 SCA6，發現小腦以外的表現相當普遍——感覺症狀 72.2%、疲倦 64.7%、腱反射亢進 38.9%、不寧腿 28.6%、排尿障礙 27.8%（n=18、橫斷面，盛行率不可外推）。SCA6 是本社日本申請的兩個適應症之一，若病人的實際負擔有相當比例落在 SARA 量不到之處，純以 SARA 為主要指標的療效訊號就可能與病人自覺獲益脫節，與 08/08 收錄的 SCA27B 眼動個案指向同一方向。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢近 7 天內無新療法型試驗——SCA 圈層當日更新為 Baltuch 的小腦 DBS（NCT07752095）與福建醫大的經顱時間干擾刺激（NCT07743866），皆屬神經調節、依 §1b 不予收錄；SBMA 組一如既往混入五筆前列腺癌試驗，逐筆確認後排除。競品新聞掃描（Biohaven、仲恩／REPROCELL、Vico、Arrowhead、安基、Alterity）未見近 7 天內的新事實。排程缺口說明：上次發布的 commit 時間戳為 08/11，但其內容為 08/10 的掃描（該次執行跨過午夜），08/11 當日實際上未執行掃描；本次查詢一律採近 8 天／最後更新日新→舊排序，已涵蓋該日，無資料缺漏。

en.body: Two papers added, both pointing at the same question: what are we measuring besides SARA? The Cerebellum published a multicentre validation in 74 patients with cerebellar degeneration across seven Japanese hospitals, deriving an Adaptability Index from a standardised touchscreen Prism Adaptation Test, testing inter-hospital robustness with linear mixed-effects modelling and comparing variance between the SCA6 and SCA31 genotypes; the index correlated negatively with SARA (r = −0.364, p < 0.01). It is an uncommon endpoint candidate grounded in objective task performance rather than rater judgement — but the correlation is only moderate, and the study does not show greater sensitivity to disease progression, which would need longitudinal data. The author list is the core of Japan's ataxia clinical research network. Movement Disorders Clinical Practice (Federal University of São Paulo) assessed 18 genetically confirmed SCA6 patients and found extracerebellar features to be common — sensory symptoms 72.2%, fatigue 64.7%, hyperreflexia 38.9%, restless legs 28.6%, urinary dysfunction 27.8% (n=18, cross-sectional; prevalence figures cannot be extrapolated). SCA6 is one of the two indications in our Japanese application, and if a meaningful share of patients' burden lies where SARA cannot reach, an efficacy signal resting on SARA alone may diverge from the benefit patients perceive — the same direction as the SCA27B oculomotor case recorded on 08 August. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned no new therapeutic trials within the past 7 days: the SCA-ring updates were Baltuch's cerebellar DBS study (NCT07752095) and a transcranial temporal interference stimulation study from Fujian Medical University (NCT07743866), both neuromodulation and ineligible under §1b, while the SBMA query again pulled in five prostate cancer trials, excluded after checking each record. The competitor news sweep (Biohaven, Steminent/REPROCELL, Vico, Arrowhead, AnnJi, Alterity) found no new facts within the past 7 days. Note on a scheduling gap: the previous publication carries a commit timestamp of 11 August, but its content was the 10 August scan (that run crossed midnight), so no scan actually ran on 11 August. Today's queries all used an 8-day window and most-recently-updated ordering, which covers that day; nothing was missed.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻與 2 筆過去漏收的既有療法試驗。試驗雷達補上 NCT07215416——波士頓兒童醫院 Timothy Yu（客製化 n-of-1 ASO 療法先驅）主持的 atipeksen Ph1/2，以剪接切換型 ASO 針對 ATM 基因 c.7865C>T 突變治療共濟失調微血管擴張症（A-T），n=10、2026/08 起收案；以及 NCT05302271——Weill Cornell 的 AAVrh.10hFXN Ph1a/1b 基因療法，值得注意的是其標的為 Friedreich's Ataxia 的心肌病變而非神經症狀，n=25、2022 啟動、收案中。兩筆都是共濟失調圈層的療法型試驗，此前不在平台上；漏收原因與 08/06 補收安基兩筆時相同——兩者登錄最後更新分別停在 2026-05 與 2026-03，依「最後更新日新→舊」排序的例行掃描排不進前 40 名。文獻方面新增 Acta Neurologica Taiwanica 兩例 Sjögren 症候群合併急性小腦共濟失調並檢出抗神經元抗體的個案報告，與遺傳性 SCA 無直接關係，收錄理由是免疫性小腦共濟失調在臨床上可與遺傳性 SCA 高度相似，屬篩選排除標準的參考。另 Molecular Neurobiology 之 Machado-Joseph 病 citalopram 更正啟事（PubMed 42550340）本日再度出現在近 7 天檢索結果內，惟該筆已於 08/06 查核判定原文為 2019 年舊作、非新事實而不予收錄，本日維持原判斷。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（本日全數正常回應，昨日 500 錯誤的 episodic ataxia／CACNA1A 組已重試成功）近 7 天內無新療法型試驗——SCA 圈層當日更新為 Baltuch 的小腦 DBS（NCT07752095）與福建醫大的經顱時間干擾刺激（NCT07743866），皆屬神經調節、依 §1b 不予收錄。競品新聞掃描（仲恩／REPROCELL、Biohaven）未見近 7 天內的新事實：Biohaven 的 CRL（2025-11）與本社日本承認申請、美國 Ph2 進度均為平台既已記錄的事實。

en.body: One paper and two previously missed therapeutic trials added. The trial radar gains NCT07215416 — the atipeksen Ph1/2 run by Timothy Yu at Boston Children's Hospital, a pioneer of bespoke n-of-1 ASO therapy, using a splice-switching ASO against the ATM c.7865C>T mutation in ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T), n=10 and recruiting from 2026/08 — and NCT05302271, Weill Cornell's AAVrh.10hFXN Ph1a/1b gene therapy, notable for targeting the cardiomyopathy of Friedreich's ataxia rather than its neurological features, n=25, started 2022 and recruiting. Both are therapeutic trials in the ataxia ring that were not previously on the platform, and they were missed for the same reason as the two AnnJi trials backfilled on 06 August: their registry records were last updated in 2026-05 and 2026-03 respectively, so a routine scan sorted by most-recently-updated never reaches them within the top 40 results. On the literature side, Acta Neurologica Taiwanica reported two cases of Sjögren's syndrome with acute cerebellar ataxia and anti-neuronal antibodies, which bears no direct relation to hereditary SCA and is recorded because immune-mediated cerebellar ataxia can closely mimic hereditary SCA clinically — reference material for screening and exclusion criteria. Separately, the Molecular Neurobiology correction notice to a citalopram paper in Machado-Joseph disease (PubMed 42550340) reappeared in today's 7-day search results, but that record was already checked on 06 August and excluded because the underlying article dates from 2019 and carries no new fact; that judgment stands. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries all responded normally today (the episodic ataxia / CACNA1A query that returned HTTP 500 yesterday was retried successfully) and surfaced no new therapeutic trials within the past 7 days: the SCA-ring updates were Baltuch's cerebellar DBS study (NCT07752095) and a transcranial temporal interference stimulation study from Fujian Medical University (NCT07743866), both neuromodulation and ineligible under §1b. The competitor news sweep (Steminent/REPROCELL, Biohaven) found no new facts within the past 7 days — Biohaven's Complete Response Letter (2025-11) and our own Japanese filing and US Ph2 progress are all facts the platform already records.

body: 新增 4 則科學文獻與 2 筆既有競品試驗。Neurology（芝加哥大學）以問卷世代（SCA6 282 人、SCA27B 127 人）分析發病與嚴重度的相關因子，結果一分為二：SCA6 由基因主導（女性、非白人族裔、CAG 越長者發病越早），SCA27B 則與農藥接觸、病毒感染等環境暴露關聯較強——若成立，該亞型的試驗設計必須把這些暴露納入分層。該文作者群列有 Solaxa（SCA27B 適應症競品）隸屬，顯示其正在建立自家的自然史／病人分群基礎。Movement Disorders Clinical Practice（祕魯＋史丹佛）三例個案改用長讀定序後全部推翻原本的 SCA10 判定，主張 ATXN10 100–150 中間長度等位基因未必致病、RP-PCR 不足以定診——對採用外部自然史對照的試驗特別關鍵，分型誤判會同時稀釋療效訊號並污染對照組。JBC（北卡教堂山）解析 SCA48 的 STUB1／CHIP 變異，指出共伴護蛋白與 E3 連接酶雙功能會依 domain 不同而分離，是該亞型臨床異質性的來源（生化／細胞層級，且目前無公司推進 SCA48 臨床開發）。Case Reports in Neurology（斯洛伐克）單一 SCA27B 病例追蹤 14 個月，病人用 4-aminopyridine 後臨床改善但客觀眼動量測幾乎沒變，提示眼動終點與病人感受可能不同步（單一病例，不能推論療效）。試驗雷達補上兩筆過去漏收的既有競品試驗：Larimar NCT06447025（nomlabofusp 開放標籤延伸，Ph2、n=85、收案中）——即先前 NCT06681766 兒少試驗受試者「直接轉入」的那一項，先前只記錄了轉出端；以及 Biohaven NCT06529146（troriluzole 真實世界對照研究，n=909），即該公司 NDA 主張「延緩病程 50–70%」的證據來源、該 NDA 已於 2025-11 收到 CRL。收錄判斷說明：NCT06529146 登錄類型為觀察性，依手冊 §1b 原則本應排除，但其為競品法規申請的直接證據基礎、且介入品項即 BHV-4157，故例外收錄並在 status 欄標明觀察性設計的推論限制。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢無新療法型試驗（SCA 圈層當日更新為 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史、Baltuch 的小腦 DBS、福建醫大的經顱時間干擾刺激，皆屬神經調節或觀察性，不予收錄）；episodic ataxia／CACNA1A 該組查詢回傳 HTTP 500，當日未取得結果，明日重試。競品新聞掃描（Biohaven、Vico、Arrowhead、安基、仲恩／REPROCELL、Solid Biosciences、Larimar）未見近 7 天內的新事實。

en.body: Four papers and two previously missed competitor trials added. Neurology (University of Chicago) analysed correlates of onset and severity in a survey cohort (282 with SCA6, 127 with SCA27B) and found the two subtypes split: SCA6 onset is driven mainly by genetics (female sex, non-White race, longer CAG repeats), while SCA27B shows stronger associations with environmental exposures such as pesticide contact and viral infection — if it holds, trials in that subtype will need to stratify for those exposures. The author list carries an affiliation with Solaxa, a competitor developing for SCA27B, indicating it is building its own natural-history and stratification base. Movement Disorders Clinical Practice (Peru + Stanford) re-analysed three suspected SCA10 cases with long-read sequencing and overturned every one of them, arguing that intermediate ATXN10 alleles of 100–150 repeats may not be pathogenic and that RP-PCR alone cannot diagnose — especially consequential for trials relying on an external natural-history control, where misassignment both dilutes the efficacy signal and contaminates the comparator. JBC (UNC Chapel Hill) dissected STUB1/CHIP variants in SCA48, showing that the co-chaperone and E3 ligase functions come apart in a domain-dependent way, which accounts for the subtype's clinical heterogeneity (biochemical and cell-level work; no company is currently pursuing SCA48 clinically). Case Reports in Neurology (Slovakia) followed one SCA27B patient for 14 months: the patient improved clinically on 4-aminopyridine while objective oculomotor measurements barely moved, flagging that eye-movement endpoints and patient-perceived benefit may not track together (a single case; no efficacy can be inferred). The trial radar gains two existing competitor studies that had been missed: Larimar's NCT06447025 (nomlabofusp open-label extension, Ph2, n=85, recruiting) — the very study that participants in NCT06681766 were rolled into, where previously only the exit side was recorded — and Biohaven's NCT06529146 (troriluzole real-world comparison, n=909), the evidence source behind the company's claim of 50–70% slowing of progression in the NDA that received a Complete Response Letter in November 2025. Note on an inclusion call: NCT06529146 is registered as observational and would normally be excluded under §1b of the operating manual, but it is the direct evidentiary basis of a competitor's regulatory filing and its listed intervention is BHV-4157, so it is included as an exception with the limits of the observational design stated in the status field. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned no new therapeutic trials (the SCA-ring updates that day were an NEI natural history study in SCA7, Baltuch's cerebellar DBS trial and a transcranial temporal interference stimulation study from Fujian Medical University — all neuromodulation or observational, none eligible); the episodic ataxia / CACNA1A query returned HTTP 500 and produced no results today, and will be retried tomorrow. The competitor news sweep (Biohaven, Vico, Arrowhead, AnnJi, Steminent/REPROCELL, Solid Biosciences, Larimar) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days.

body: ＊本次為 08/07–08/08 兩日合併掃描：08/07 排程未執行（該日無發布），已一併回補。新增 3 則科學文獻。Movement Disorders（洛克斐勒大學）以人類死後腦組織檢驗 SCA3 病人普金氏細胞內的突變 ATXN3 CAG 重複是否隨年齡持續擴增，結果為擴增幅度極小、與小腦顆粒細胞相當且比紋狀體神經元穩定，作者認為體細胞重複擴增不足以解釋普金氏細胞的選擇性退化——若在更大樣本重現，代表亨丁頓舞蹈症近年最熱的「抑制體細胞擴增」路線（如鎖定 MSH3）在 SCA3 的理論基礎較弱，相對之下 Vico VO659 這類直接降低突變蛋白的路線機轉正當性更穩固。Nature Cell Biology（聖猶達兒童研究醫院）發表合成基因調控分子 SynGR1，結合 frataxin 基因內重複序列並招募 BRD4，讓 RNA 聚合酶 II 穿越抑制性 HP1 凝聚體、在甲基化標記仍存在下重啟 FXN 表現（細胞層級、無動物或人體資料）；此為共濟失調圈層出現的新模態類別，但須標明機轉界線——Friedreich's 是功能喪失、polyQ 型 SCA 是功能獲得，「叫醒基因」的策略無法直接移植。Cortex（法國里爾大學）比較健康對照、帕金森氏症與 SCA 三組的節律引子效應，規律節律在三組皆縮短語音起始時間，提示語音起始時間可能是比整體構音評分更敏感的量化指標，對次要終點與數位語音生物標記設計有參考價值。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢兩日內無新療法型試驗：SCA 圈層 08/07 的兩筆更新分別為 NEI 的 SCA7 自然史研究與小腦深部腦刺激試驗（NCT07752095，神經調節），依收錄準則皆不予收錄。另記一筆查核以免日後重複誤判：SBMA 查詢回傳的 NCT07190300「TulmiSTAR-02」（Ph1/2、收案中）逐筆核對後確認為 Novartis 的 tulmimetostat 併用 darolutamide 治療轉移性荷爾蒙敏感性前列腺癌，非 SBMA，屬手冊已載明的雄性素受體同義詞擴展汙染。競品新聞掃描（Biohaven、Vico、Arrowhead、安基、仲恩／REPROCELL、IntraBio、Solid Biosciences）未見近 7 天內的新事實；搜尋結果中出現的新潟大學 L-arginine SCA6 試驗（48 週 SARA 差異未達統計顯著，p=0.0582）為 2024/12 舊聞，不予收錄。

en.body: *This is a combined 07–08 August scan: the scheduled run did not execute on 07 August (nothing was published that day) and has been backfilled here. Three papers added. Movement Disorders (The Rockefeller University) used human post-mortem brain to test whether the mutant ATXN3 CAG repeat keeps expanding inside the Purkinje cells of people with SCA3; the expansion proved minimal — comparable to cerebellar granule neurons and more stable than striatal neurons — leading the authors to conclude that somatic repeat expansion does not account for the selective loss of Purkinje cells. If it replicates in larger samples, it implies the rationale is weak in SCA3 for the route currently hottest in Huntington's disease, suppressing somatic expansion via targets such as MSH3, and correspondingly firmer for lowering the mutant protein directly, as Vico's VO659 does. Nature Cell Biology (St. Jude Children's Research Hospital) reports the synthetic gene regulator SynGR1, which binds the repeat DNA inside the frataxin gene and recruits BRD4 so RNA polymerase II can traverse the repressive HP1 condensates, restoring FXN expression while the methylation marks remain (cell-based only; no animal or human data). It marks a new modality class in the ataxia ring, but the mechanistic boundary must be stated: Friedreich's ataxia is a loss of function while polyglutamine SCA is a gain of function, so waking a silenced gene does not transfer across. Cortex (Univ. Lille) compared rhythmic priming across healthy controls, Parkinson's disease and SCA; regular rhythms shortened speech initiation time in all three groups, suggesting speech initiation time may be a more sensitive measure than a global articulation score — relevant to secondary endpoints and digital speech biomarkers. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries returned no new therapeutic trials across the two days: the two SCA-ring updates on 07 August were an NEI natural history study in SCA7 and a cerebellar deep brain stimulation trial (NCT07752095, neuromodulation), neither of which meets the inclusion criteria. One verification is logged to prevent the same misreading later: NCT07190300, "TulmiSTAR-02" (Ph1/2, recruiting), returned by the SBMA query, was checked record by record and is Novartis's tulmimetostat combined with darolutamide in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, not SBMA — the androgen-receptor synonym-expansion contamination already documented in the operating manual. The competitor news sweep (Biohaven, Vico, Arrowhead, AnnJi, Steminent/REPROCELL, IntraBio, Solid Biosciences) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days; the Niigata University L-arginine trial in SCA6 that appeared in search results (48-week SARA difference not statistically significant, p=0.0582) dates from 2024/12 and was not recorded.

body: 臨床試驗雷達補收安基生技 AJ201 的兩筆試驗——NCT05517603（首次用於病人之 Ph1/2a、n=25、2023/02–2024/04、六家美國站點）與 NCT07549919（2026/04 之健康受試者食物效應／PK 試驗，收日本裔與白人男性各半）。此二筆先前未在雷達內，安基的公司情報卡試驗欄因而長期為空，今日補齊。漏收原因值得記錄：前者條件欄雖登記 SBMA，但自 2024/08 起未再更新，依「最後更新日新→舊」排序的例行掃描永遠排不進前 40 名；後者條件欄登記為「健康男性受試者」而非 SBMA，任何以疾病為條件的查詢都查不到。掃描程序已據此新增「已知資產藥名點名查核」每週一次，以補疾病條件查詢的盲區。另新增 1 則科學文獻：Brain Communications 發表兩株新的重組新表位抗體 1B12 與 11G2，用於偵測 HTT1a（CAG 擴增造成異常剪接而生的高致病性聚集蛋白），在小鼠模型上以 HTRF／MSD 平台勝過現行標準抗體 MW8；CAG 擴增驅動的異常剪接是 polyQ 疾病（含 SCA1/2/3/6/7）共通的機轉假說，聚集體定量靈敏度直接決定 Vico VO659 這類 CAG 鎖定療法的臨床前藥效解析度（純小鼠試劑方法學，無人體資料）。另 Molecular Neurobiology 刊出一則 Machado-Joseph 病 citalopram 論文的更正啟事，原文為 2019 年舊作，非新事實，不予收錄。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）當日無新療法型試驗。競品新聞掃描（Biohaven、Vico、Arrowhead、安基、仲恩／REPROCELL、IntraBio）未見近 7 天內的新事實——Arrowhead 08/04 發布 2026 會計年度第三季財報，全文未提及 ARO-ATXN2 或任何 SCA 項目。⚠️ 發布備註：本日內容推送至版本庫後，GitHub Pages 連續三次建置失敗（13:21、14:40、14:52 UTC，每次跑滿約 10.5 分鐘後逾時；對照 08/05 正常建置僅需 55 秒），姊妹站 MSA-IQ 同時段亦兩次失敗，故本日更新上線時間延後。已查證：全部 16 個資料檔編碼與 JSON 格式皆正常、版本庫僅 19 個檔案共 721KB、GitHub 官方狀態頁顯示 Pages 服務正常，判斷為建置管線側問題而非內容錯誤。您能讀到本則即表示建置已恢復。另本日將頁首「本週新增」KPI 校正回手冊定義（近 7 天內實際新增進文獻／試驗／情報摘要的筆數，經 git 紀錄逐筆核算為 7 筆）；先前數值口徑較寬、含七月下旬平台建置期的批次補錄，數字下降屬口徑校正，非系統停擺。

en.body: Two AnnJi Pharmaceutical trials of AJ201 were backfilled onto the trial radar — NCT05517603 (first-in-patient Ph1/2a, n=25, 2023/02–2024/04, six US sites) and NCT07549919 (a 2026/04 food-effect and PK study in healthy Japanese and White male volunteers). Neither had been on the radar, which is why the trials panel of AnnJi's company card had been empty; both are now recorded. The reason they were missed is worth noting: the first is registered under SBMA but has had no registry update since 2024/08, so a routine scan sorted by most-recently-updated can never reach it within the top 40 results; the second is registered under "healthy male adults" rather than SBMA, so no condition-based query can find it at all. The scanning procedure now includes a weekly asset-name roll-call to cover this blind spot. One paper was also added. Brain Communications reports two novel recombinant neoepitope antibodies, 1B12 and 11G2, for detecting HTT1a — the highly pathogenic aggregation-prone protein produced by aberrant splicing as the CAG repeat expands — outperforming the current standard MW8 antibody on the HTRF and MSD platforms in mouse models. Aberrant splicing driven by CAG expansion is a mechanistic hypothesis shared across the polyglutamine diseases including SCA1/2/3/6/7, and the sensitivity of aggregate quantification sets the resolution at which CAG-directed therapies such as Vico's VO659 can be read preclinically (reagent methodology in mice only; no human data). Molecular Neurobiology also published a correction notice to a citalopram paper in Machado-Joseph disease, but the underlying article dates from 2019 and carries no new fact, so it was not recorded. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA, Friedreich, SBMA, polyglutamine, episodic ataxia/CACNA1A) returned no new therapeutic trials today. The competitor news sweep (Biohaven, Vico, Arrowhead, AnnJi, Steminent/REPROCELL, IntraBio) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days — Arrowhead released its fiscal 2026 third-quarter results on 04 August, and the release makes no mention of ARO-ATXN2 or any SCA programme. ⚠️ Publishing note: after today's content was pushed to the repository, the GitHub Pages build failed three times in a row (13:21, 14:40 and 14:52 UTC, each running about 10.5 minutes before timing out, against 55 seconds for a normal build on 05 August), and the sister site MSA-IQ failed twice over the same period, so today's update went live later than usual. Checks made: all 16 data files are valid UTF-8 and valid JSON, the repository holds just 19 files totalling 721KB, and GitHub's own status page reported Pages as operational — pointing to the build pipeline rather than to any error in the content. If you can read this entry, the build has recovered. The header "new this week" KPI was also recalibrated today to the definition in the operating manual — the number of items actually added to the literature, trial and intelligence feeds in the past 7 days, counted item by item from the git history as 7. Earlier values used a broader basis that included the batch backfills from the platform build-out in late July, so the drop reflects the change of basis, not a stalled system.

body: ＊本次為 08/04–08/05 兩日合併掃描：08/04 排程未執行（該日無發布），已一併回補。新增 2 則科學文獻：BMJ Case Reports 報告一名以頸部肌張力不全表現、症狀出現十年後才確診的 CACNA1A 相關脊髓小腦萎縮症病例（此基因即 SCA6／發作性共濟失調第 2 型，也是 IntraBio 第三期 NCT07221292 的族群，診斷延遲直接影響該圈層的可收案人數）；Stem Cell Research 建立四株 SCA12 病人來源 iPSC 品系（PPP2R2B 非編碼區 ≥43 CAG，屬非 polyQ 亞型、不在 Stemchymal 適應症內）。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）兩日內僅兩筆更新，分別為經顱時間干涉刺激（神經調節，非療法型）與 SCA 自然史研究，依收錄準則不予收錄。競品新聞掃描（Biohaven、Vico、Arrowhead、安基、仲恩／REPROCELL）未見近 7 天內的新事實。

en.body: *This is a combined 04–05 August scan: the scheduled run did not execute on 04 August (nothing was published that day) and has been backfilled here. Two papers added. BMJ Case Reports describes a patient who presented with cervical dystonia and was diagnosed with CACNA1A-related spinocerebellar ataxia only ten years after symptom onset — the same gene behind SCA6 and episodic ataxia type 2, and the population of IntraBio's Phase 3 trial NCT07221292, so the diagnostic delay bears directly on the enrollable population in that ring. Stem Cell Research reports four patient-derived iPSC lines for SCA12 (≥43 CAG in the non-coding region of PPP2R2B — a non-polyQ subtype, outside the Stemchymal indication). The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA, Friedreich, SBMA, polyglutamine, episodic ataxia/CACNA1A) returned only two updates across the two days — a transcranial temporal interference stimulation study (neuromodulation, not a therapeutic) and an SCA natural history study — neither of which meets the inclusion criteria. The competitor news sweep (Biohaven, Vico, Arrowhead, AnnJi, Steminent/REPROCELL) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days.

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻：Neurological Sciences 綜述長讀定序在神經疾病基因診斷的角色，明列脊髓小腦萎縮症為已展現效益的適應症（大型重複擴增正是短讀定序的盲區），並整理 DNA 品質、分析負荷、成本與可近性等待解限制——與 SCA 試驗的基因型納入與分層條件直接相關。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）本日無清單外的新療法型試驗；Friedreich 圈層近日更新的四筆中，Solid Biosciences SGT-212（NCT07180355）已在追蹤名單內，其餘三筆為觀察性或數位評估研究，不予收錄。競品新聞掃描（Biohaven、仲恩／REPROCELL 等）未見近 7 天內的新事實。今日為週一，已產出週報草稿檔並建立 Gmail 寄件草稿（2026/07/28–08/03，待人工審閱後手動寄出）。

en.body: Added 1 paper. A review in Neurological Sciences sets out the role of long-read sequencing in the genetic diagnosis of neurological disease, listing spinocerebellar ataxia among the conditions where the benefit is already demonstrated (large repeat expansions being precisely the blind spot of short-read sequencing), and collects the outstanding limits around DNA quality, analytical burden, cost and access — all directly relevant to genotype-based eligibility and stratification in SCA trials. The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA, Friedreich, SBMA, polyglutamine, episodic ataxia/CACNA1A) surfaced no therapeutic trials outside the tracked list today; of the four recently updated records in the Friedreich ring, Solid Biosciences' SGT-212 (NCT07180355) is already tracked and the other three are observational or digital-outcome studies and were not recorded. The competitor news sweep (Biohaven, Steminent/REPROCELL and others) surfaced no new facts within the past 7 days. Being a Monday, the weekly report file covering 2026/07/28–08/03 was produced and a Gmail draft created, awaiting manual review before it is sent.

body: 新增 2 則科學文獻：Annals of Neurology 以 ATXN3 敲入小鼠證明 SCA3 的周邊感覺神經病變源自突變 ataxin-3 的毒性功能獲得，且僅在感覺神經元中沉默突變基因即可改善——指出背根神經節是鞘內給藥的基因沉默療法需一併覆蓋的區室；另一則為 medRxiv 預印本，以長讀定序拆解 ATXN2 周邊單體型與 CAA 中斷數的關係（三個中斷在對照族群約 1%、在中間長度重複的 ALS 個案約 55%）。ClinicalTrials.gov 五組適應症查詢（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyglutamine／episodic ataxia-CACNA1A）本日無清單外的新療法型試驗，既有試驗狀態亦與平台紀錄一致。

en.body: Added 2 papers. In Annals of Neurology, ATXN3 knock-in mice show that the peripheral sensory neuropathy of SCA3 arises from a toxic gain of function of mutant ataxin-3, and that silencing the mutant gene in sensory neurons alone is enough to improve it — arguing that dorsal root ganglia are a compartment intrathecally dosed gene-silencing therapies must also reach. The second is a medRxiv preprint using long-read sequencing to dissect haplotypes around ATXN2 against CAA interruption count (three interruptions being present in about 1% of controls but about 55% of ALS cases with intermediate repeats). The five ClinicalTrials.gov condition queries (SCA, Friedreich, SBMA, polyglutamine, episodic ataxia/CACNA1A) surfaced no therapeutic trials outside the tracked list today, and the statuses of tracked trials match what the platform already records.

body: 市場覆蓋矩陣補到零缺口：12 個目標市場的治療型與製造生態系兩層全數有對象。法國原本雙缺，補入 Cell-Easy（土魯斯，CellReady 異體 MSC 平台，2026-01 與 CHU Toulouse 啟動 A-MUSE Ph1/2）、CELLforCURE by SEQENS 與 CellProthera；澳洲補入 Cell Therapies Pty Ltd，該廠已通過 TGA／FDA／EMA／PMDA 查核並持有日本 MHLW 認證，因與本社日本審查時程耦合而列為優先序 1；瑞典補入 CCRM Nordic（與既有加拿大 OmniaBio 同一組織網絡）與 ATMP Sweden；瑞士補入 Avrion Therapeutics。比利時補入 BioSenic（原 Bone Therapeutics），但誠實標註：其 ALLOB 異體 MSC 於 Ph2b 療效未達而擱置、公司已轉向非細胞資產，該市場治療型層實質上仍是空的。公司層 75→83 家、合作分析 73→81 筆。

en.body: The market coverage matrix now has no gaps: all 12 target markets carry counterparties in both the therapeutic and manufacturing-ecosystem layers. France, previously empty on both, gains Cell-Easy (Toulouse, whose CellReady allogeneic MSC platform entered the A-MUSE Ph1/2 with CHU Toulouse in January 2026), CELLforCURE by SEQENS and CellProthera. Australia gains Cell Therapies Pty Ltd, a site inspected by the TGA, FDA, EMA and PMDA that also holds Japanese MHLW accreditation, ranked priority 1 because its relevance is coupled to the Japanese review timeline. Sweden gains CCRM Nordic, part of the same organisational network as the existing Canadian OmniaBio line, along with ATMP Sweden. Switzerland gains Avrion Therapeutics. Belgium gains BioSenic, formerly Bone Therapeutics, with an honest caveat: its ALLOB allogeneic MSC missed efficacy at Phase 2b and was shelved while the company moved to non-cell assets, so that market's therapeutic layer remains effectively empty. The company layer grew from 75 to 83 and the partnering analysis from 73 to 81 entries.

body: 新增「合作機會」分頁與市場覆蓋地圖：涵蓋 12 個目標市場、三層對象共 68 家的逐家合作分析。公司層由 45 家擴充至 70 家，補進仲恩既有價值鏈成員（Cyto-Facto、Terumo BCT、Histocell）、台灣 6 家再生醫療同業，以及先前完全空白的國際製造生態系。另查證具名兩筆原本匿名的細胞治療對手：賽萊拉 Sclnow（中國，NCT03378414，Ph2、n=45、涵蓋 SCA1/2/3/6）與全新發現的 Biocells Medical（波蘭，NCT07467733，Ph1/2、n=90、鞘內＋鼻內給藥）——後者因登錄病名寫作 spinocerebellar palsy，先前的關鍵字掃描未命中，掃描條件已據此擴充。⚠️ 合作對象分析原訂維持內部、不上公開站，經重新拍板改為公開發布。 當日第二輪掃描另補收 1 則文獻（Movement Disorders 遺傳性共濟失調分類架構回顧）。

en.body: Added a Partnering tab and a market coverage map: a company-by-company partnering assessment covering 68 companies across 12 target markets and three layers. The company layer grew from 45 to 70, adding Steminent's existing value-chain members (Cyto-Facto, Terumo BCT, Histocell), six Taiwanese regenerative medicine peers, and an international manufacturing ecosystem that had been entirely absent. Two previously anonymous cell therapy rivals were also identified: Sclnow of China (NCT03378414, Ph2, n=45, covering SCA1/2/3/6) and the newly discovered Biocells Medical of Poland (NCT07467733, Ph1/2, n=90, intrathecal plus intranasal) — the latter had been missed because its registry entry names the condition spinocerebellar palsy, and the scan criteria have been widened accordingly. Note that the partnering analysis was originally to be kept internal and off the public site; that decision was revisited and it is now published. A second scan pass the same day added one further paper (a Movement Disorders review of hereditary ataxia classification frameworks).

body: 補收長期漏掉的日本競品 Kissei 橘生製藥 rovatirelin（KPS-0373）之現行樞紐試驗：藥證 2023/07 撤回後重啟的第三次 Ph3 確認試驗已登錄 NCT07040137（日本多中心、隨機雙盲安慰劑對照、n=142、24 週、主要指標 SARA 總分，2025/07 起收案、估 2027/03 主要完成）——同一監管機關、同一主要量表、市場範疇與本社日本承認申請重疊，威脅等級由「低」調整為「中」，並新增競品全景一列、更新公司情報卡與試驗結果讀出。另補收 SCA27B 學術 Ph3（NCT07185347）：法國 AP-HP 以 fampridine（4-AP 緩釋 10mg BID、12 週、n=70、9 中心）治療 SCA27B，與 Solaxa SLX-100 同分子；同步補上 Solaxa 2026/02 與 Alvogen 的全球授權（最高 9,500 萬美元里程碑＋兩位數權利金）。另收 Larimar 兒童 FA 之 Ph1（NCT06681766，登錄狀態「終止」但理由為行政性轉入開放標籤，非安全性問題）。新增 3 則科學文獻：anti-Yo 免疫性小腦退化 vs SCA1 之小腦形態學比較（巴黎腦研究所）、SCA 診斷延遲與五項眼科鑑別線索（墨西哥）、以失智為首發的 SCA17 家族案例與表現型譜回顧。

en.body: Captured the current pivotal trial of a long-missed Japanese competitor, Kissei Pharmaceutical's rovatirelin (KPS-0373): the third Ph3 confirmatory study it restarted after withdrawing its Japanese application in 2023/07 is registered as NCT07040137 (multicentre in Japan, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, n=142 over 24 weeks, total SARA as the primary endpoint, recruiting since 2025/07 with primary completion estimated 2027/03). Same regulator, same primary scale and a market scope overlapping Steminent's Japanese application, so its threat level moves from low to mid; a competitor-landscape row was added and the company card and results readout were updated. Also captured the academic SCA27B Ph3 (NCT07185347), in which AP-HP in France is testing fampridine (prolonged-release 4-AP 10 mg twice daily for 12 weeks, n=70, nine centres) — the same molecule as Solaxa's SLX-100 — and filled in Solaxa's 2026/02 global licence with Alvogen (milestones of up to $95 million plus double-digit royalties). Larimar's paediatric FA Ph1 (NCT06681766) was added as well, noting that its TERMINATED status is administrative — participants moved directly into the open-label study — not a safety issue. Three papers were added: a cerebellar-morphometry comparison of anti-Yo immune-mediated degeneration versus SCA1 (Paris Brain Institute), diagnostic delay in SCA with five ophthalmic differentiating clues (Mexico), and a dementia-first SCA17 family case with a phenotype-spectrum review.

body: 主動發現清單外競品 Solid Biosciences（NASDAQ: SLDB）：Friedreich's Ataxia 基因療法 SGT-212 首次人體 Ph1b（NCT07180355）自 2025/10 收案中，採雙側小腦齒狀核注輸＋靜脈雙途徑遞送——正對應 Biogen BIIB132 折戟的深部小腦遞送難題；已建立競品全景、公司情報卡與試驗各一筆，追蹤競品數 20→21。另補收 PTC Therapeutics 新 Ph3「PROVE-FA」（NCT07681713，n≈120、24 個月、主要指標 mFARS、估 2026/08 起始），惟為單臂開放標籤無對照設計。新增 3 則科學文獻：SCA3 類澱粉聚集抑制（肉桂芽多酚，線蟲模型）、SCA3 認知障礙靜息態 fMRI（n=84）、共濟失調病人自述視功能與眼動關聯（MGH／哈佛）。

en.body: Discovered an off-list competitor, Solid Biosciences (NASDAQ: SLDB): its Friedreich's ataxia gene therapy SGT-212 has been recruiting into a first-in-human Ph1b (NCT07180355) since 2025/10, using dual-route delivery via bilateral cerebellar dentate-nucleus infusion plus IV — aimed at the deep-cerebellar delivery problem that sank Biogen's BIIB132. Added as a competitor-landscape row, a company card and a trial; tracked competitors 20 → 21. Also captured PTC Therapeutics' new Ph3, PROVE-FA (NCT07681713; n≈120 over 24 months, primary endpoint mFARS, estimated start 2026/08), though it is single-arm, open-label and uncontrolled. Added 3 papers: suppression of ataxin-3 amyloid aggregation by cinnamon-bud polyphenols in a C. elegans model, resting-state fMRI in SCA3 with cognitive impairment (n=84), and patient-reported visual function and its oculomotor correlates in ataxias (MGH / Harvard).

body: 新增 1 則科學文獻：SCA2 前臨床期辨識的多變量 MRI 模型（Tomography，墨西哥／古巴 Holguín 團隊）——以多項 MRI 線性測量區辨健康對照、ATXN2 前臨床帶因者與已發病者，整體準確率 80.7%（前臨床 AUC 0.75）。五組適應症 CT.gov 掃描（SCA／Friedreich／SBMA／polyQ／CACNA1A）近 7 天無清單外新療法試驗，SBMA 組命中皆為前列腺癌雄性素路徑試驗之字面誤中；本社與 Biohaven、Vico、Arrowhead 亦無新監管或臨床動態。

en.body: Added 1 paper: a multivariate MRI model for identifying the preclinical stage of SCA2 (Tomography; Mexican / Cuban Holguín groups) that discriminates healthy controls, preclinical ATXN2 carriers and manifest patients with 80.7% overall accuracy (preclinical AUC 0.75). The five-indication CT.gov sweep (SCA/Friedreich/SBMA/polyQ/CACNA1A) found no off-list therapy trials in the last 7 days — the SBMA hits were all literal false matches from prostate-cancer androgen-pathway studies — and there was no new regulatory or clinical movement from Steminent, Biohaven, Vico or Arrowhead.

en.body: Added 4 papers. The systematic review of MSC therapy for cerebellar ataxia (CNS Neurosci Ther, Kyungpook National University, Korea) directly supports an allogeneic strategy — MSCs from ataxia patients have weaker anti-inflammatory secretome capacity than healthy-donor MSCs, and efficacy in the SCA2 model held even when dosing began after symptom onset. Also added an SCA2 N140 electrophysiology biomarker, an SBMA muscle-MRI imaging biomarker (Neurology) and a review of polyQ multisystem pathology. Discovered an off-list competitor, Nido Biosciences (NIDO-361, an oral SARM in SBMA / the adjacent polyQ ring): its Ph2 (NCT06411912, n=54) showed no advantage over placebo on the primary muscle-MRI lean muscle volume endpoint, results were posted to the registry in 2026/03, and the company wound down in early 2026 — now recorded as a competitor-landscape row, a company card, a trial and a results readout. Tracked competitors 19 → 20.
